Brok has an additional +30% bonus for forges.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200: Craftsmen

[strike]Upgraded tools get an additional +10% production bonus[/strike]

When in the same zone, Warchiefs mine and forge 50% faster.

Selling {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.png Iron earns +20% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns. Neutral factions will accept {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.png Iron.

Allies and neutral factions receive double resources.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500: Earth Legacy

You discover 2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone and 2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.png Iron deposits in your territory.

[strike]You can build a second Relic[/strike] -> Zones with or adjacent to an active relic gain +15% production.


Lore Tree

Metalcraft has been removed.

Quality of Life replaces Erudition.

Völund Fire (New) replaces Mining Efficiency:

[strike]Each Warchief mining {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.png Iron earns +4 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore[/strike] -> Warchiefs produce 5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore for each ore extracted.

Ancestral Influence:

[strike]Relics don't use a building slot. Zones with or adjacent to an active relic gain +5% production.[/strike] -> Relics don't use a building slot. You can build a second relic (max 1 relic per zone).

Forging a relic takes 50% less time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4844333d05b58bd8528190c5a01f816c48a0c505.png

https://j.gifs.com/NOj7xm.gif


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200: Supplies

[strike]Each year a boat brings you +50 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png Wood and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns, +25 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore and +5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone.[/strike] -> Each 200 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame a boat brings you +50 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png Wood and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns, +25 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore and +5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500: Dedication -> Annexation

[strike]All productions get +1% per 100 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame.[/strike] -> For each 200 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame, the Colonization price is decreased by 5% and unit production is increased by 3%.

Food Preservation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5bf642b9e727743ef4e87cecbdbafe318538284e.png

Draconic Frenzy

Dragonkin

Dragonkin recruitment price increases by [strike]15[/strike] > 10 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Kröwns for each Dragonkin you already own.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/588f2dd3747d833a1403684e194dcf3761eee48a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/70e149b04f307ac74d3067a03be91faeddf08dd4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/508e92648cbb8e48b4975feb5aeeb80e3e9fd2e2.png

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4383580d7522129b36f97164bf777eb926a6246b.png
Over the next week (or so) we will be testing a new multiplayer lobby and rank system, which will involve close cooperation between ourselves and our wonderful community to understand and improve the current balance of the Northgard multiplayer systems and we'd like you all to get involved.

How do I access the Open Beta update?

1. Right click on Northgard in your Steam Library.
2. Select Properties, then the Beta Tab.
3. Enter the password - ezHZkuze5zaqe4
4. Select beta-new-update in the drop down.
5. Download the update and launch the game.

Patch notes can be found here (You will need to copy and paste this into your browser as Steam is flagiing the link as potentially malicious for some reason) - https://docs.google.com/document/d/10hwsOUYrj9aUTVymPtajucLEF8YdO_Db7q04QlntIuQ/edit?usp=sharing

Provide your feedback over on Discord - https://discord.gg/C5EzXsHvvg

Key points to focus your feedback on:


 Impact of the first 10 games on your rank
 Your rank progression
 (Player) skill balance in lobbies 
 Military paths

notes.title: Northgard Update 2.7.4.24816 - out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/8198f9fb1170454eb15f859e7b3d70f1b69e576d.png

 Hello everyone! Today we have released an update that addresses a number of issues  that have arisen since the release of the Clan of the Rat. 

Whilst this update doesn't directly address the loss of progression some users are reporting, it does include implementations that will ensure that this does not happen again in the future and we are continuing to look into ways we can resolve the issues of those affected. 

Read on to find out more... 

General

 Sickness: Sick clan members regain 50% less health from healing.

Rat
Overwork 

 Production is increased by 50% > 30%.

Enrollment

 Your wounded units cost -50% > -30% Kröwns to train as military units.

Pain Suppressant

 Wounded units move and attack 30% > 20% faster.

Last Stand (Shaman forge upgrade)

 When killed, the Shaman will reduce all nearby enemies' defense by -30% > -20% for 5 seconds.

Eir (Warchief)

 Health: 75 > 80
 Attack: 15 > 12
 Defence: 10 > 9

Garm Incarnation (relic)

 Move speed has been reduced (-33%)
 Defence: 20 > 16

Bugfixes

 Garm’s Incarnation heal and decay now properly affects the unit.
 Garm’s Incarnation active bonus display now reflects the right value.
 Eradicating a neutral faction now grants the appropriate reward.
 Missing SFX added.
 Achievement progress should now be correctly tracked.
 Missing houses notification does not trigger anymore when playing the clan of the Rat.
 Offering well icon doesn’t appear as influencing a neutral faction when separated from this faction by a cliff.
 Rat conquest bonus transmitting sickness to enemy units now correctly attributes the kill of units dying from the sickness to the Rat clan.
 Rat can build Skirmisher’s camps during “Hostile Lands”.
 Players can build two different relics in conquest if they play the same clan.
 Ancient Graveyard research progression can no longer be seen through the fog.
 Display of eradicated neutral factions in the Diplomacy screen has been fixed.
 Chapter 8 secondary objective colonize Jötnar camp can be validated.
 Heal icon no longer displayed over mouse cursor when Shamans or Eir selected.
 New expeditions related to rat clan achievements have been added.
 Update no longer overrides and deletes current Stats and Conquests progress.


Known issues

 The “Continue” option for a mission in a conquest may not work (restart the mission is still available)
 Border scrolling may not work in Borderless or Windowed
 Issue with Overwork sound that stop too soon
 Blood Ties : No SFX and VFX

notes.title: Dodsvagr - The Clan of the Rat
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are proud to present to you our eighth clan, the clan of the Rat, which brings some exciting new mechanics and units to Northgard. 

Read on to find out more about what makes the clan of Dodsvagr so unique. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876990/Northgard__Dodsvagr_Clan_of_the_Rat/




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/00044b124b7083393ae077cc39a5bc7b255c0f94.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d8944f916561109152bd07589917e7f9d9939254.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/99f70cd542ec6eecf751bae869d756633bd2d52d.jpg

Welcoming wounded and outcast villagers who have been forced out of their original clans without hesitation or prejudice, it is understandable why the many followers of the Rat dedicate their life, and sometimes their death, to the clan.

The clan doesn’t have time for feasts, or even sleeping in houses, only hard work is worth celebrating, but if you have enough energy to celebrate, then you could, and should have worked harder….

The clan will work and fight tirelessly to get what they want, and to survive.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/befaa0f4ee04aed5dee949529a116bc8a2f3d20d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9edc2641e03e3cc9b5faf5478faa3bb68b68aaaa.png

Powerful shaman and merciless warrior, Eir leads the clan of the rat with an iron fist. She taught her clan the ways of the shaman, so they could survive even the most severe injuries, and ensure their enemies do not.

Some say that her mastery of dark practices goes as far as being able to bring back dead beasts from the depths of Helheim...



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/8368929433d955da90cdd1876fc848e28c04a3ce.png
https://j.gifs.com/pZBGmy.gif

The shaman, trained by Eir, are powerful units that will fight fearlessly during the heat of battle, and take care of the injured in its aftermath. They can also lend a helping hand to their allies by healing them as well.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/2d48dbed36652a2bbdc3562f86fde44e8c1fd403.png

The clan starts with more villagers but they arrive wounded. Wounded units are exempt from {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness requirements.

https://j.gifs.com/w02Pqr.gif


The clan doesn't have access to Houses, but all non-mystical buildings provide housing. Once max population is reached, extra villagers stack in a Population Reserve.


The Shaman Camp replaces the Healer Hut and trains Shamans able to fight and heal multiple units and allies even outside your territory.

https://j.gifs.com/99GnoD.gif


When the clan’s units kill foes or die, the corpses are cremated at the Shaman Camp, producing {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore and attracting new villagers faster.

https://j.gifs.com/Eq1Dgg.gif


Overwork replaces the {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png Feast and boosts all productions at the expense of your worker's {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png Health.

https://j.gifs.com/BrOzAY.gif



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/70fe92cc802ea3d3521bcee5d34e2b112f6dedcb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200

Your units consume -50% less {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food while being healed by Eir.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500

The max Population Reserve increases by +4 villagers.
The maximum duration of Purification Pyre is extended to 6 months.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/2ae8c70688dc55915f3add3ddb485d8f5551acd9.png
Enrollment

Wounded units cost -50% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Kröwns to train as military units.


Overcrowding

You can place up to two buildings of the same type in a zone, except Defense Towers.

https://j.gifs.com/BrOzGQ.gif


Invasion

When killing neutral faction units, you gain some of their favorite tradable resources. Neutral faction buildings can house additional population.

Wounded units move and attack 30% faster.


Blood Ties

Eir can sacrifice part of her {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png Health to heal all your units in the zone over the next 5 seconds.

https://j.gifs.com/99GnvJ.gif

notes.title: Night of the living Draugar
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c3ecd58b3bb0a938430c5ccd421a7fa0e3af31fe.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/68af9d5f5b189ae0f66ae0dbae50f152f660ad1b.png
Welcome to our spooky special event where you will be able to make battle in the terrifying new Draugrheim biome.  

In this temporary game mode, you will have to conquer your fears in the land of the living dead and face terrible new (eight-legged) creatures roaming the land of Northgard. 

Vikings, it is time to take back what is yours in the Night of the Living Draugar. 

https://j.gifs.com/WPwlM4.gif

However, if you feel like some of those new creatures have more legs than you can tolerate, you can activate an arachnophobia mode in the options menu.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/2163215fa8f95fdd42626cb7cddc34204cbeb4bf.png
Finish a game of Northgard in the new Draugrheim game mode (if you dare) and earn a new Town Hall skin. You can claim it in Expeditions.

https://j.gifs.com/Y7QnK0.gif






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/96a12aff8b67aa5298db4e111ed163e7dcfb7ce4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/62dbf2bedcf49ac36bc1a2f5625ac06dc8676413.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a9639c54b8308c34e13e42bf55b4d5d7b27f915b.png

Clans Starting Bonuses:

New: Trade routes with the homeland are available and earn more {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns. [strike]Gain +10% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns from merchents and sailors[/strike] -> +15% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns production.

New: Earn {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame by scouting Neutral Factions and enemy Town Halls.

New: Great Trades Routes -10% discount.

New: You can spend {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns to accelerate the arrival of new villagers in your Town Hall.




Mercenaries from Homeland - {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200

You can send Mercenary raids from your Harbors to raid beaches but not on tiles with a Town Hall. Mercenary raids can be upgraded in the Forge.

[strike]Trade routes with the homeland is available and earn more {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns.[/strike]

New: You can assign 3 more Sailors on a Harbour with a Lighthouse




Sea Supremacy - {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500

You can send Mercenary raids on zones with a Town Hall.

[strike]You can assign 3 more Sailors on a Harbor with a Lighthouse.[/strike]

New: Mercenary Raids will use Fire Javelins, damaging buildings upon raiding.




Negotiators

Replaces [strike]Ship Building[/strike] -> Mining Efficiency.

Gain +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns production and  +30% forging speed.




Exotic Goods

Harbor, Trading Post and Marketplace produce 1 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness (2 if upgraded).




Others changes:

Raid upgrades take [strike]3[/strike] -> 6 months to forge (with 1 smith).

New: You no longer need to activate the faster recruitment of Mercenaries Raids and it no longer changes the raids' cost.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c6104fb2651a941a8a591a2cf5f25ae950d9567a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f0633f095ed39bfb1b16a016dcff9eda859dc04d.png

Howl of the Sea Master - {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500

Chance to transform an enemy military unit into a spectral warrior has been reduced.




Endless Tide

Reduces the cost of military units by [strike]20%[/strike] => 15%




Knowledge From Beyond

Reveals the position of all neutral factions. 

Trade routes with neutral factions give +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore per merchant and +20% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns and relationship.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6c48a3b8ed3a2687c3a16a87010ce832baaa1a34.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4844333d05b58bd8528190c5a01f816c48a0c505.png

Supplies - {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200

Supplies now arrive as soon as {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200 is reached instead of at the new year. Resources are then received every 12 months from the first reception. 

Each year a boat brings you +50 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png Wood and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns, +25 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore and +5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone [strike]for each completed year, and again at the start of every subsequent year.[/strike]

Known issue: The description of Supplies appears in English. Translations for all languages will arrive as soon as possible.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4210ea5f44cf70032062f95d0322c9b7d3e33b78.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/78a81b726969256d3f6fab7175446064ce33d8d0.png

Spoils of War

Gain some {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns for each enemy unit killed.

Eradicate a faction, neutral or clan, earns 50 Military XP.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b8cb33d94c162f604ca9942a95134ac0c3fd03b1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b8eec76ce154f67f64110c4e07c6e5343a15abbc.png

Mask of Gullinbursti

Produces [strike]+10[/strike] => +6 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food.

You can pay 150 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore to summon one GiantBoar. It is controllable as long as it is not in combat.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/55dced6b36ca6a5d7e8381da194bef5aa2242b49.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e67dace0a77c9d268b4f746d255634dd2f1ed2b6.png

Guerilla Tactics

Permanently increases your military units' attack power by +1% for any unit slain or lost in enemy territory (30% max).

Enemies clans relations are also affected when you are fighting a neutral faction.






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fb3c754338d618b80f55df9ba2eab04d3fa26651.png

All sailors produce +100% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame. 

The tech Knowledge from Beyond borrowed from the Clan of the Kraken with stolen lore and Mimirsbrunn no longer produced +100% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Kröwns with trade routes. 






{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/bcd5126e8cf0164a32de1190d7874414b463b055.png


Fixed difficulty noted as “extreme” in saves and as “hard” in the information window. 
Fixed fame notifications not displayed for client. 
The AI will now avoid moving its spectral warriors into ally territory. 
Fixed merchants constantly stopping work when assigned after thralls to a trading post. 
Fixed the display of ore production by slaves. 
The free lore stone obtained with the knowledge "erudition" will still be free even after cancelling it's construction.
Texts have been revised to be gender neutral. 
Torfin's throne produces +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore which was not displayed. It is now. 
Option “map special” from Ragnarok has been removed. This was irrelevant as the special map could be replaced by a volcano. 
When Kobolds spread to a tile with an object (i.e. ruins), the name display of that building/object will no longer turn into "Kobold Hamlet".
Fixed wrong icon of the relic “Edda of Vor” displayed in the player list. 
Fixed description text of Mask of Gullinbursti relic. It cost 150 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore to summon the Giant Boar (not 200).
Fixed villagers carrying hammers in longships in story mode. 
Fixed "High tide" which sometimes did not generate fish on lakes. 
Fixed broken food graphic displayed in end-game.
THE WISE ONE from the clan of the Lynx, and Torfin’s Throne no longer produce {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore in the conquest mission “Imported Knowledge”.
Fixed buildings that were burning after a raven raid. They stop burning after being repaired.
Fixed warchief portrait hiding text in fame notification.
Fixed Torfin’s shadow not attacking Wyverns and defense towers. 
Fixed several issues with neutral factions. When dwarves or myrkalfar attack an enemy clan, they continue to advance from tile to tile until they eliminate the clan or are killed. Previously, they could stagnate on a tile and cause colonisation issues, this is no longer the case.
You can no longer see enemy unit status (starving, freezing…) after using Warcry. 
The relic Gefjun’s jar now summons new villagers on the town Hall as intended. 
In the conquest mission greed’s price, the knowledge “Wool trade” no longer produces {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns. 
Clicking on the notification of a built relic no longer leads to the player who built it if you have not scouted him.  
In the gem cutter conquest mission, trading gems now affect relations.  
Building an offering well near an eradicated neutral faction is no longer possible.
The unit type icons in the healer hut are updated when healed units change jobs.

notes.title: Northgard: Kröwns & Daggers
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We are very happy to finally present to you the sixth major free update to Northgard, Kröwns and Daggers, available now!

The Kröwns and Daggers update brings a host of new features, gameplay additions and even a new neutral faction to Northgard. 

With an increased focus on diplomacy, and a complete overhaul of how you develop and maintain relations with your fellow factions, Kröwns and Daggers is easily one of our most ambitious content updates yet!

Read on to find out more about what to expect...



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/159c1495cf79907a64c25ad55a9725cbb8826b7d.png

[previewyoutube=s1wUnTy235M;full][/previewyoutube]





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a3f375300bdb053f5f8f70255ebc7380a9e127.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35565907ee9d200633bf26ad4b4ee7ae9eb67383.png
The relation system with neutral factions has been reworked. Each faction now presents 4 relation statuses offering new rewards and risks depending on how you treat the faction. 

All new interactions with Neutral factions and Clans are reunited in a new Diplomacy screen. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fc801047906dbf8ad3e8a785092fd9bbadbe6168.png




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6ca47f3cf8a9ab95976d3348fdda94e4ca61e395.png
A new building is available to improve your relations with the neutral factions: the Offering Well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c5bd686ab5a203001e6c81b5fac2df89907eac80.gif




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/45705ede921c8d191556257d7351615dbf1430f2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e3333341c73d9e6d724f2c207ee456e36392d688.png


The Dwarves are joining the Northgard party!

Dwarves, well known for their mining prowess, will obviously have access to and supplies of many treasures and precious resources but come too close, and you might regret it... 

On the other hand, they might lend you a helping hand if you manage to gain their trust.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/30fd3465f7f3611eac93f4edcf22cc1277dbbfe1.png

Interactions with rival clans are evolving: 

While scouting, the borders of territories under the Fog of War are now colorless. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/490264fcd633912d90da3b6faf6010de0ab56ab5.gif


By sending your scouts to spy on an enemy's Town Hall, you may access new information like their Lore-tree or resource stocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6f68e917c5c8603f944418f55fba57fbe3b97ddd.gif


In addition, notifications regarding the other clans now feature the portrait of their Warchiefs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3572e97812838beaafbe25a86a03298b9fe4e018.png







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/878bfc76d7d382221387ec591f5ae644ec39b1c7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/979b6946bf9692798ec31639f07c659b4d0292d0.png
Based on the information you’ve gathered, you can now declare an enemy clan as your Rival, for a gain, but at a cost:

Town twinning boosts your population growth, but it also increases the population growth of your Rival.
Eavesdropping gains you more {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore based on how much Knowledge your Rival has discovered that you have not.
Target a Clan with less {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/cf0a8a06979151066f4d428b573b5c6edf8e3e82.png Fame than you with Bullying and you will gain more {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e7c2fec2a1b00e46f5d824e031ac55bbdf0d75e6.png Defense against them, but if they come out on top, they get significantly more {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame in return.
Manhunt places a target on your Rival’s back by hitting them with an {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9f1986148a58aa976c2ac94a51d9f313b68b5d5f.png Attack malus outside their territory. In exchange, they get a bonus as long as they stay within their territory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/dd56778ca32bca370b977ce8600b37ce0916cb9a.png




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/46485cc1d0daa02f3aa5d2cade52ee9f862212d1.png
To establish this Rivalry, a new building is available: the Emissary Lodge and corresponding unit, the Emissary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3ead182195d8c3fb8f300fbdc63ae79da4272754.gif







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9f405155cf95a0cd5080007c28eee2f39df073d.png

New competitive events for you to take part in against the other clans for a reward. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d228bbfe3825bfbe3bd3ec92e154a8580b039d42.gif







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d3c05f7b839986abc62a856e580776d2b0aba581.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/81eaa3090f067c9775d6f869be1eca639fe0d0c0.png

Kill 3 enemy Dwarves Champion in a single game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d4586361da0bb1d40785fa036f5917844e89c013.png

Win a game with every started neutral faction alive and not befriended by anyone.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/31e61c265a7947c91a69279fcbb3dc308498eec7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0a0c40032a497f0c4b04daf01ee5f3e2e266fe1d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5b3f454af6ac49ac4a2a56686e4c7c787ddacbd0.png

Eliminate 5 neutral factions after they were befriended by another clan.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5018f0a71edbcb58b4457c39bef80732daa5b17d.png

Send a scout to spy on 3 different clan's Townhall in a single game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ca27e7111a3d83b0084c1e26570d63d55e13b6e.png

Maintain for 2 years "Eavesdropping" Rivalry with a clan doing the same with you.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6b59cbaa57546cba7c27a3c25ff933cb833495ca.png

Eliminate a clan targeted by your "Bullying" Rivalry.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/90914b8b86f2972b2399ae65c400486e5019e9f5.png

Be the target of 3 Manhunt Rivalry at the same time.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e111417b8c03da1050d6522ef2e3c4b11de0b641.png

Win a competitive event in which all clans have participated.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/7e12ff7c98c9ad9f57dcdd26777811b5139c14b4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b12df95586c534366b97388f14f35e47e52bb922.png
Player names are now displayed in the chat, but they are colorless until scouted (and so are the borders).
When a player pauses the game, the player name is displayed to all players.
When a player ends the pause, the name of that player is also displayed.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/ef4daf865d2f531da85707fb5f3fad1b8e3d25d9.png
Stats for Squirrel Meals have been added.
In {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food stats, the {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png Feasts are now indicated.
In Forge stats, the Unit forged is now indicated.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0c3143190f623b8687ba0104456a4b51ce6ce8ca.png
Coinage (and similar Knowledges that unlock trade routes):

Coinage no longer unlocks trade routes.
Trade routes are available since the beginning of the game.
Trade routes without Coinage are less effective than before
Knowledges replacing Coinage in the Lore Tree also benefit from the trade route bonus "Your trade routes produce +100% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Kröwns".

Erudition:

[strike]The first Carved Stone is free.[/strike] Your next carved stone is free.

Knowledge from Beyond:

[strike]Reveals all neutral factions.[/strike] Reveals the position of all neutral factions (without removing the fog of war).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore cost:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore cost for knowledges has been readjusted.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3715cebe9d439529168fa44b153f6555fa5ba96b.png
New unit: Emissary. 
New building: Lodge of Emissaries.
New building: Offering Well.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a7b97f703330ae220245716f78f7df3cf698a8f8.png
The Dwarven Prospectors.
The Myrkálfar's Levy.
Ceremonial Bonfire.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/46378f8da8a8b7204afc3a7950b57764e0612fee.png
Neutral factions attack behavior reviewed to fairer.
Jötnar now charges enemy units when attacked on their own territory.
All factions except Jötnar now accept {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png Wood via trade routes.
Every clan of the Dragon in a game now has the same Dragon Essence gauge bonuses.
Rumor mongering was reworked to match with the new neutral factions’ behaviors.
The detailed flux of your resources (the tooltip over a resource stock) now displays the flux as a decimal value. Meaning you can know precisely how much {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone / {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.png Iron you’re extracting and trading.
Scouting speed is reduced by 20% in enemy territory. 
With the shortcut E you could lose the selection of Kaija by selecting/deselecting her army. This feature was removed. 
Eradicating a neutral faction no longer gives military XP (eliminating a member of the neutral faction will still provide military XP).
Eliminating a player no longer gives you military XP.
Several SFX have been added. 







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b83843b18d8df261c83a75cafc375870d6138a6b.png

Wounded debuff on Units is now correctly removed when healed.
Wounded debuff only applies once under 80% of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png health.
Oskoreia is no longer canceled when Mieliki is attacked.
Achievement “Let me borrow this” is correctly unlocked.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness detail now shows the entire list of entries impacting {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png happiness and not just the X first elements.
Multiple bugs about achievements/expeditions not triggering upon completion.
Fixed value display for Knowledge “value of great deeds”.
Fixed Snake’s relic Stealth ability.
Fixed Trading Caravan. Relations with neutral factions improved 20% faster as intended. (Instead of 10 before correction).
Fixed victory condition cut-off in story mode.
Fixed trade with the clan of the Boar. As the Boar, you can no longer trade with another clan.
AI of the clan of the squirrel can no longer share a meal with an ally before obtaining “A Helping Hand” ( {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200). 
Icon displayed after a loot no longer cancels a mouse click. 
The link to the "How to mod" button has been fixed. 
Fixed the Bodyguard from “Tactician” Military Path sometimes no longer following his warchief.
Fixed cursor issue. You could sometimes no longer target an enemy unit with your military units. 
Fixed console spam causing lags in modded games. 
Fixed achievements in the expedition menu. Some of them were unlocked in the game but not on steam. It was the game that considered them unlocked too early.
In the lobby, the dropdown list no longer closes automatically when you’re selecting a clan and another player choses at the same time. The dropdown list still closes if you’re selecting a color or team at the same time as another player.
Myrkalfar no longer stall and teleport when they attack on server.
Fixed army selection with ‘E’ and a giant Boar.







{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5651eb196422c753dd2babe6afe9ca8c384c1e1a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1b3fb9c1b86a8c7052146982c92e9f54753dc0fc.png
All the new Kröwns and Daggers features are not scriptable for mods at this time. This will be possible very soon. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/dd495484e928542291c8d15e40193d61bcf24568.png
A few sentences in the Rivalry window will only appear in english. They will soon be available in all of the supported languages.

notes.title: Balancing Patch 7 - July 2021
notes.content:
Happy Tuesday Vikings!

Today, we’re releasing a yet another MASSIVE balance patch that brings a plethora of changes to Northgard and each of the clans that inhabit these mysterious lands. 

With this update, we've made a number of changes and additions, heavily balancing the clans based on your wonderful feedback over the last few months and fixed a multitude of issues that have been reported in the time since our last major update!

You can find the whole list of what’s been addressed below!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/15d368ce463628c9f9ef0369b338f5fd0d505122.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/abe13b582d5b502f53ef9d7967426ca9eec63af3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4d0ccd9cd2cff85b3ccb387a476ab4bf12dd97e3.png


Recipe

Fish fillets : 

+1 month cost: [strike]200 vegetables[/strike] 200 fishes
Mining / Forging Bonus [strike]25% / 50% / 75% / 100%[/strike]  => 50% / 75% / 100% / 125%

Fishes were accumulating too much. We want you to use meals other than Venison & Ratatouille and Meat Stew.



Prices of meals in Food is increased depending on the number of clan you share the meal with: 

1 clan : population  x 2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png food 
2 clans : population [strike]x4[/strike] => x 6 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png food 
3 clans : population x 6 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png food 
4 clans : population x 8 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png food 


Clan's Description

[strike]Special Squirrel Win Condition[/strike]  → Special {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame Victory for the clan of the Squirrel is removed and replaced with a new {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 1500. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200 - A Helping Hand

( +5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame per player affected by a meal)



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500 - Plot of the Thrones

You gain {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame based on your extra population compared to your most populous opponent. Arrival of new villagers increases by 5% every 100 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame.

Increased amount of {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame earned from extra population based on your most populous opponent.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 1500 (3rd level) - Most Beautiful Banquet

Unlock a specific new recipe at the Stove
1.000 Meat, 1.000 Fish, 1.000 Vegetables, 1.000 Mushrooms
It takes 3 months to prepare
While preparing this recipe, all other recipes are not available
Every clan is notified and invited at the great Banquet
When the preparation is complete, the game is won

Allowing or not {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame Victory have no more relations with Special Squirrel Win Condition.



Rumor-mongering

No other clan can befriend any neutral faction which has become your ally. This faction gains +20%  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e7c2fec2a1b00e46f5d824e031ac55bbdf0d75e6.png defense against all your enemies. It also becomes more aggressive towards them (this also affects Jötnars).

If neutral factions are befriended and you have Rumor Mongering, they will attack as soon as possible.

Your units gain Cloaked within these factions' territories.




Economics

You gain +4 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png krowns during meals and all meals gain +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness (Only {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness bonus is shared with ally clans)




Relic Yggdrasil's Root

The chances of being disturbed are reduced.

In some cases we saw that the discord effect of Eldritch zones turning enemy units against one another was too efficient, so we reduced its defensive power slightly.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9ad3df23674d3bfd08220cfcb247bbae346fb255.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/70e149b04f307ac74d3067a03be91faeddf08dd4.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500 - Oskoreia

Oskoreia ability:

Cast time : [strike]0[/strike] => 1.5 sec
Oskoreia spirits disappear 10% faster 


Relic : Gleipnir

The Trap no longer triggers the instant the player clicks on the skill.

It triggers in 2 steps : First, the trap appears on the area with no effect, then after 3s the trap inflicts damage. 

It lets the enemy react and leave the zone to decrease the effects on its army.



Sharp Eyes

You can now use Lynx with Sharp Eyes like Scouts.



Hunting paths

Double arrows:

[strike]30%[/strike] => 20% damage on the second arrow. 




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/720c18ccaeadae1fbf9bae62dbe1a78fa1a0b0cf.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/8202086ceef7cc0dc723ee48885ab17e4d5ffc3d.png

Ox is a late game clan, but it was a bit off the curve compared to other clans: too weak in early game and too strong late game. We increased early game power and reduced late game power.


Torfin

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9f1986148a58aa976c2ac94a51d9f313b68b5d5f.png Attack power [strike]15[/strike]  => 14



Torfin's Throne

Torfin's Throne now produces +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore when Torfin is not summoned.



Military Training

Military units in territory produce military XP.

Upgrade cost for Training Camps [strike]-50%[/strike]  => -30%



Ferocious Charge

Warriors gain [strike]+50% [/strike] => +30% damage on a charge attack. 





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/10812fb14ef206aa7118cf1b34db8cd71602b300.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f0633f095ed39bfb1b16a016dcff9eda859dc04d.png

The Clan of the Kraken was too map generation dependent and we wanted to give it more control.


Starting Bonuses

Fresh fish tech is removed and become a starting bonus

+20% fishermen production. 



Valkyrie Units

Valkyries produce +1 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness.

Valkyries regenerate {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png Health near Horgr.



Knowledge From Beyond

Trade routes with neutral factions +20% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png krowns and relationships.



Foresight replaces [strike]Medicine[/strike] => Colonization



Valhalla’s reinforcement - replaces Legendary Hero

You will have 1 Valkyrie at your Town Hall and you can control +1 Valkyrie. Valkyries also regenerate {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png Health on High Tides tiles and outside combat. Passive regeneration increases by 100%. 



Wyrd - High Tides

Now makes fish appear in lakes if there are none.



Army of the Dead (new conquest bonus)

No more {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness penalty when specter warriors are in your territory.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1bb646b785f2556795d38b13d3f4f991967ab002.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/af24f315069050d99a883c517ebdfbffe83d4add.png

We’ve heard that {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200 Craftsmen became less impactful. We buffed it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200 - Craftsmen

Improved tools for civilians get an additional [strike]+5%[/strike] => +10% production bonus.

Selling {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stone or {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.png Iron earns +20% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png krowns. Allies receive double resources.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e79d6a94af6765cc3d95ac12da444e7ac19891b1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5bf642b9e727743ef4e87cecbdbafe318538284e.png

The relic was weak, we improved it.


Skull of Hrungnir

Zombie Giant has its move speed increased.

Zombie Giant costs [strike]200 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food 100 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png krowns[/strike]  =>  200 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a5fd5136f010a6b0a1df6b6c5cf024046d01615a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e67dace0a77c9d268b4f746d255634dd2f1ed2b6.png

The Clan of the Snake is complicated to balance. We are reinforcing Skirmishers to encourage some early-game interactions.


Skirmishers

Dodge +10%

The way the dodge is effective has been overhauled.



Black Market

Trading with neutral factions no longer reduces relations with them.



Relic Gungnir

All military units Dodge + 10%

Unlocks the Stealth ability for all your military units.

Stealth : Can’t be targeted by Watch Towers for [strike]5s[/strike] until attacking it





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0160f21a1fad9feb30a2fd9b2f3bd86e0be9c609.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b8eec76ce154f67f64110c4e07c6e5343a15abbc.png

Majority of complaints for this clan were about the weak Gullinbursti relic.  “Pay food to get food”, we changed that and gave a bit of control over the Giant Boar.


Bartering

Trade routes with neutral Factions +20% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png krowns and relations +1 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png happiness per trade route.



Osmosis replaces [strike]Trading Caravan[/strike] Negotiation



Relic Mask of Gullinbursti

+10 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food (even if the Giant Boar is not summoned)

[strike]Reveals all forests.[/strike]

Pay 200 [strike]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food[/strike] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore to summon one non controllable Giant Boar. 

Giant Boar is not controllable while in combat.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/25c5775217c9bd0c7d14c51009da840a0842ebec.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f81d7e838917c4fc0970b891d191aa74691d0c6d.png

Relic was a bit too strong, so we’ve changed the way it works to avoid the perma freeze.


Relic Scabbard of Gram

Your Warchief wields the sword Gram. Enemies hit by Gram are frozen, along with the area around them. Gives +10% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9f1986148a58aa976c2ac94a51d9f313b68b5d5f.png attack +10% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e7c2fec2a1b00e46f5d824e031ac55bbdf0d75e6.png defense to shield maiden.

Apply Chilling Aura : freeze enemies hit and adjacent and apply penalties:

-15% attack speed
-15% move speed
effect lasts 2s 
       → 5s cooldown


Kaija

When on a tile with lake fishes (neutral or ally territory), Kaija regenerates {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png Health and produces +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0fd92f82006fd2852145ee76d0c558fd9498881f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4844333d05b58bd8528190c5a01f816c48a0c505.png

Very strong in rush builds, good everywhere with a strong economy, the Clan of the Stag was more powerful than all the other clans in Northgard.


Value of the Great Deeds

Skalds produce 1.5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png krown [strike](+2 when upgraded)[/strike]

Skalds tools are free and -50% forge time



Food Preservation

+3 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food for each Silo (+5 if upgraded)

[strike]+1[/strike] => +0.5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Happiness per silo (+1 if upgraded).



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200

[strike]Gain +150 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food +150 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png Wood +150 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns +75 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore +10 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stones[/strike]

You gain +50 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png Wood and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Krowns, +25 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Lore and +5 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e9a2c1910734b187b4e95d172ca13ff17d971506.png Stones for each completed year, and again at the start of every subsequent year.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5029c94b1c5c6fcd1b06f553e0c1c5974fce109b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a9639c54b8308c34e13e42bf55b4d5d7b27f915b.png

The Clan of the Raven is very dependent on beach tiles and thus map generation. We tried to give the clan more control by reducing this dependence. We also redesigned Mercenaries to make them more central to the Clan identity and rebalance their impact, which was too strong against beginner players and too weak against experienced ones.


Negotiators (replace Shipbuilding instead of Mining Efficiency)

Unlock the lighthouse. 

Gain +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Kröwns production and 10% Commercial Influence.

Increases Sailors’ resource production by 20%. 



Mercenaries from Homeland ({STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200) 

You can hire Mercenaries from your Harbor and send them to raid coastal areas without a Town Hall on it. Allow to trade with your Homeland at better rates. 

[strike]+3 Villagers, +3 pop max, +1 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png happiness[/strike]

Upgrades for your raids are available at the forge.



Sea Supremacy ({STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500)

[strike]RavenPort can hire mercenaries for {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png krowns[/strike]

You can send your Mercenaries to coastal zones with a Town Hall. 

More upgrades for your raids are available at the forge. You can assign 3 more Sailors in your Harbor with a Lighthouse. 



New upgrades availables in the Forge 

Upgrades available in the Forge at {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 200 → 

More Mercenaries : Add 2 mercenaries to the raid. 	
Better Preparation: Reduce the time it takes to recruit by 1 month

Upgrades available in the Forge at {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500 → 

You can upgrade your mercenaries at the Forge	
Up to 3 times for 2 more mercenaries per Raid and a maximum of 8 mercenaries per Raid
Better Preparation: Reduces the time it takes for Mercenaries to approach the coast 1 month
Fire Javelins: The mercenaries fleet throws fire javelins that damage and burn the zone’s buildings. 


Mercenary unit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9f1986148a58aa976c2ac94a51d9f313b68b5d5f.png Attack power : [strike]10[/strike] => 8

Mercenary tool forge upgrade : +20% projectile defense +40% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9f1986148a58aa976c2ac94a51d9f313b68b5d5f.png Attack power.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/7b531884f0ac160983b210487f46a98d24cd7603.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9ce2cea7d8c1492ae1aac1b49368206cf6130000.png

Lots of changes to the Goat. We want to give him back his identity.


Clan description

Goat units get -20% military XP



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png Fame 500

You gain 1 free feast per year. Your Defense Towers gain 25% resistance when feasting. 



Amenities

Costs [strike]80%[/strike] => 50% less to develop a zone.

notes.title: Ratatoskr - The Clan of the Squirrel
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e3762e2ad74ca52fbbf80e5e7867221143c08ae5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c87a276db35948f0fd02aff2025e93c8a7c6f0c9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d73efcdd0ee85c8033c96635b390a43c06581ca7.png

Led by Andhrímnir, the Clan of the Squirrel knows better than most how to enjoy the present moment but not at the expense of being farsighted and expert at managing resources.

Their talented cooks are able to prepare delicious meals that improve the abilities of the clan and their allies. For all that, their warriors and prowess on the battlefield should not be underestimated!

Furthermore, with Ratatoskr as their totem animal, the clan is also adept at using manipulation and sowing discord in order to further their goals!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/00a5435df1d3cb628b8a1a4100b1f20050c514c1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/648748205705f5a4b081e6b7246eb11f953d9b34.png

Named after the Æsir’s cook, Andhrímnir displayed unprecedented skills in the culinary arts from a young age, despite fierce competition within the clan. As fearless and authoritarian in the kitchen as he is on the battlefield, Andhrímnir has everything one would expect from... a “warchef”!




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/51f0d4ed1156d5f24dccd41f8b226ccd86eb16cc.png

The clan hoards greedily in anticipation of winter 2 months before it begins and can count on a +30% increase in production during this period. However, they have a harder time during winter itself as they consume more {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.pngFood and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.pngWood (+15%).

The Squirrel clan gathers ingredients in its territory, depending on the zones’ types.

The Stove replaces the Brewery, where Cooks can prepare meals, providing massive bonuses.

The clan can achieve the unique Ratatoskr Victory: reach {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.pngFame 1500



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/cc11cf402f879f73a1775ae10d187564d60ced8d.png
A Helping Hand - {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.pngFame 200


You receive a set of random ingredients by boat and you increase your ingredient storage by 200.

You can prepare Meals for your allies, for an additional {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.pngFood cost.

You unlock Gift Routes at the Trading Post.
Gift Routes allow you to share your resources with other clans. It is the best way to build good relationships with potential allies. It also works very well with Northgard neutral factions (3 times better than normal trade routes).



Plot for the Throne


You gain {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.pngFame based on your extra population compared to your most populous opponent.

Arrival of new villagers increases by 5% every 100 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.pngFame.
With this, you will have all the tools you need to achieve your unique Ratatoskr Victory by outclassing any enemy that dare to face you.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/eb1889343780642e0dc4ffab4cf7533f4e36317c.png
As your clan pushes its borders, it has access to more Ingredients for each new zone it exploits that can be used for creating great Meals :

Meat: Meat is a good source of protein and {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.png iron, harvested from big mammals such as deer and wild boars.

Fish: Fish is a source of protein and phoshorus harvested from both freshwater and saltwater specimens.

Vegetables: "Vegetable" is an umbrella word which covers pretty much every edible vegetal organism, including roots.

Mushrooms: Mushrooms refer to any type of fungus that was found to be edible through painful-to-lethal trial and error.

Cooks can be assigned to any Stove. They bring {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.pngHappiness to your clan, and more importantly, help produce Ingredients. If need be, Andhrímnir can also help produce Ingredients by being assigned to the Stove. 

Gather as many Ingredients as possible to ensure you’re always ready to prepare powerful meals.

https://j.gifs.com/DqkQky.gif


The Squirrel clan knows how to cook 6 recipes that will help you conquer Northgard:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/515e8a9b1d375d622c45c69bcf63272ddeb255f5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.pngFood, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.pngWood, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.pngLore, {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.pngKrowns production bonus


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/74124d9456d3ae5a9a237f34bcaa27955107f7ca.png
Forge speed bonus
Mining speed bonus


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/debad64056eb42075e44591080da3795e8952aa8.png
Winter resistance bonus
Scouting speed bonus


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f115048723b4d2adbd26f87c785f83842755bbd0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.pngHealth regeneration
Scouting speed bonus


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/7477a76bd7c6e409fcd81df116f5a237334791d6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e7c2fec2a1b00e46f5d824e031ac55bbdf0d75e6.png Defense unit bonus
Projectil resistance bonus


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/043f3dc86c897b0d6349606eb2da807abdf9083e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d80f134a6dc707a6cc2cd0114f073d0158ca4328.pngAttack power bonus
Military XP bonus


Each Meal must be prepared with enough common {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.pngFood as an additional cost. This {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png Food cost increases sensibly if you wish to include your teammates to your table!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/cbbc407e2cbb0301366a32faa347f5fb0eddf88b.png

Each clan can benefit from one meal per Squirrel clan. New meals replace the previous one. But having many Squirrel friends means taking advantage of multiple meals at the same time! 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4221a8717e0473cf7238149daba7be6287809ec6.png
Ratatoskr is famous for scurrying from Yggdrasil's branches to its roots, instilling doubt and discord in the mind of its enemies. The Squirrel clan perpetuates this legacy to keep itself out of harm’s way.

The zone where Yggdrasil's Root is built becomes “Eldritch." After every period of one year, one zone in your territory adjacent to an eldritch zone also becomes Eldritch.


Units in Eldritch zones benefit from periodical production bonuses.

Enemy units in an Eldritch zone have a chance to fight against their own kin for 5s.

https://j.gifs.com/6W8Yxz.gif

If an Eldritch zone becomes neutral, it reverts back to normal.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9080be04863fe974ec415b5b7ff339a9870a8f25.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f671d471e10a5e405b0f5f9fa13ac8468ffe7c7a.png

- Replaces Colonization -

+1 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.pngFood / {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.pngWood production bonus for each 100 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.pngFood / {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.pngWood in stock (max +10). Not affected by winter malus.

Your Silos do not require building slots.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4401658c0b12e597063c2dee7edd62d9c4987e76.png

- Replaces Hearthstone -

Meal bonus level: +1

Meal {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.pngFood cost: -20%



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/19ee0e3ab242dc87175436de12095aba8435467a.png

- Replaces Weaponsmith -

Your next warchief recruitment is free. (no {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.pngKrowns, no {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/35a6fc81b6608a273e0f8125afe871d2c09d8b9c.pngIron)

Reviving warchief cooldown: -50%.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6bb02ad1f156b6df5282f57b3d0578b2fbbbf9c9.png

- Replaces Mining Efficiency -

Every {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.pngKrowns incomes gets +10%.

Meals gain additional effects : +2 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.pngHappiness +4 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.pngKrowns.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/33d3b0149ea0f58c5cec784d773100831812ec86.png

- Replaces Negotiate -

No other clan can befriend any neutral faction which has become your ally. This faction gains +20% {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e7c2fec2a1b00e46f5d824e031ac55bbdf0d75e6.png Defense against all your enemies. 

It also becomes more aggressive towards them (this also affects Jötnar).

Your units gain “Cloak” within these factions' territories.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4da8bf895ac2d65cd570420b20d4a3a9c5369a7e.png
1st Battle

Ingredients production +20%

You can benefit from multiple meals at the same time.


6th Battle

Stoves can hold one more Cook.


11th Battle

+1 level for Meals




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/8f15b12c394e890f7daea8630208f7a7e3d8e17e.png

notes.title: Balancing Patch 6 [MARCH 2021]
notes.content:
Hello Vikings!

Today, we’re releasing a huge (possibly even our biggest yet) balance patch that will bring widespread changes to Northgard and all of the formidable clans that inhabit it! 

We’ve made a number of massive changes across the board, introducing new ways to approach the game and manage your people as you strive for conquest and you can see the whole list of what’s new below!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e917ce75886a1e550060e333a6d2f2919053318a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/92b30308db917ccf337775f4de69bcbd0b28fe6d.png
The Guardian Military path is still considered to be too weak, and as the vast majority of players usually choose between Tactician and Conqueror, it is being buffed:

⇒ Militia behavior

Militia is now controllable by player 
Militia still cannot leave the player’s territory
Militia cannot be assigned to any other role
The Militia respawn frequency has been increased
The maximum of Militia is back to 2 / 4 / 6

⇒ Suppressing Fire

-50% WatchTowers upkeep 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/41202cea9a2888ca6e1451e59c844e35aa5b36fe.png
The objective here is to give more space to other military units and give more value to warband upgrading: 

Warrior recruitment cost: [strike]20 krowns[/strike] {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png => 30 krowns {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png
Each new military unit increases the next cost by [strike]+5[/strike] => +6 krowns {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png.
The Watch Tower building cost : [strike]60[/strike] => 50 woods {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png , upgrade remains unchanged.

notes.title: Viking RTS Northgard gets new 'Expeditions' content in free update
notes.content:
Viking-themed RTS game Northgard has been quietly dominating since its full release in 2018 (after spending a year or so in early access before that). It received some pretty positive reviews, and the team at Shiro Games has been slowly making the game even better over time.
In the years since, Northgard has received several major free updates that have added new content and game modes, such as the Conquest mode, the Ragnarok map, even a map editor. Now, the game is set to get a fifth major update.
Expeditions is not a new game mode, but it represents a new way of interacting with existing Northgard content. They're essentially quests, and these missions are broken up into steps. One step might see you colonise a specific tile, or reach another milestone connected to gameplay. Once you've done the first step, the next is revealed. There are two types of expedition - recurring ones in the form of daily and weekly quests, and 'master expeditions' that are one-time missions relating to existing content. There are expeditions related to the original story mode - Rin's Saga - as well as quests for the Conquest mode, and ones tied to Steam achievements.

Hey Everyone! 

We are proud to announce and release our 5th major expansion for Northgard: Expeditions! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/89e44c8a84cce4a0c3c0afc5c3ee67fc11e71731.png

This patch introduces a new way to enjoy Northgard content and free cosmetics you can craft with in-game rewards! (And only ever via in game rewards, you will never have to pay money for these cosmetics)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/eba225e72d82be1f462d4670cb7033bbd7de8542.png

Expeditions are small quests structured in a few hidden steps. Each step asks you to accomplish in-game objectives such as Colonizing a specific tile, Producing resources or Reaching a certain amount of Happiness. Completing a step reveals the next one. Your actions are taken into account for every visible steps, so you can complete multiple objectives at once.
 
There are two types of expeditions:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/dc7d1ce0c6f91dad06812cc58f5b1a497a54f6c3.png
DAILY TRIP

It is an expedition you can complete every 24 hours that reward your first games of the day!


WEEK-LONG JOURNEY

This expedition is given out each week, that selects its objectives within a difficulty-based pool. The first step will always be Easy, the second one is a Normal type, the third id Hard to complete and the last is Extreme. Of course, they offer rewards accordingly. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/dfcc0e4a419317272568e977cd37d17ee0ece988.png
These expeditions reward you for completing Northgard content. They can only be achieved once. 

Rig’s Saga expeditions focuses on the main story, 
Conquest expeditions help you follow your progress in the game mode, 
Achievements expeditions cover Steam achievements. As there are now included in-game, you can easily track them and get rewarded each time you unlock one. (available in a few days)





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ffe9cca47ca4afbe7b44d2f0343d8d6cd09d754.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/314cde536be0421888a0dc6e6e9470319a6dd6df.png
You bring back treasure chests from your expeditions. With each objective completed, you can open a chest revealing silver. The chest generosity depends on the objective difficulty. Conquer with peril and triumph with glory!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/ca5ddc307093f8a8230e0df731416197e9f0f387.png
You can use your silver to craft cosmetics in the Treasures menu. You will find new Warchief skins and Townhall skins, offering you alternative in-game appearance for your Warchiefs and Townhalls. We also introduce a new type of cosmetic, the Decorations, to embellish your Townhall zone.

Each skin has its own Rarity, from Common to Legendary.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3bf1a09d616fa8671933677b6b2d2fcaeee64a41.png
You can craft up to 57 different cosmetics: 

12 Warchief skins, split in two collections: Brutal & Ceremonial.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c620f89cfc3a86da3a8d680e1ab5fa155151372b.png

20 Townhall skins.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6b3517286da1cc180acffbeb72706fae89d223ba.png

25 Decorationss featuring banquets, fireplaces, gates and totems. 

Completing all expeditions assure you to grasp the entire collection!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9d9392be3567094e65df4a3d7b0c980ba68bfee7.png
Your previous inventory remains untouched. Players who already own warchiefs skins from Rig’s Saga and townhalls skins from Conquest will keep them. 

Rig’s Saga warchief skins and Conquest townhall skins are now part of the Treasure menu. They still require to complete Rig’s Saga on Extreme difficulty and to finish clan Conquests to unlock. Their initial requirements remain unchanged.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d4e2c4af82ad7f85e833a860b9101b28c104ce56.png
Equip skins and decorations directly from the Treasures menu.
Initial options to equip skins have been deactivated. 




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6305f30750cc37547699cc556fa4e8684592a438.png

We are entering Season 6, The Sons of Sigurd, with this patch. 

We brought some changes to the Ranked system. 

From now on, a season now lasts three months and a new one automatically starts when the previous ends. Ranked totems are no longer buildings but Decorations you can acquire in the Treasures menu. They still require to get the according rank, thus getting Ranked totems remains the ultimate way to show off your rank. 




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/956b220f070b84e88088313bf7d00110f67c55e9.png
With this update, we also bring you another BIG surprise: The official Northgard Artbook! 

With the french publishing house Omaké Books, we have created the first and only official Northgard Artbook: The Art of Northgard. 

Within these pages, we'll be sharing an in-depth look at the development journey of Northgard. From the conceptualisation, research, and trial and error that led to our initial 2D prototype, all the way to the final release that our players have sunk mil-lions of hours into. 

And as you guys come to everywhere in the world, we decided to make The Art of Northgard a bilingual Artbook. It then includes french and english in the same book!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3d74421c398b93b43409a411f72e13a08af02992.png
You can now pre-order the Collector's Edition of The Art of Northgard artbook, which includes:

The Art of Northgard 178 page artbook
An exclusive A3 poster
A cardboard display stand with its 3 collector lithographs of the Clan of the Wolf, Boar and Stag
An exclusive Townhall to use in-game - only for the PC version
A numbered certificate of authenticity - limited to 1000 copies


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b92a2a331098d4ddd8ae1a66363f3a02bbf1c442.png

The Collector's Edition is now available on pre-orders only for a delivery within the end of March. 

Pre-order The Art of Northgard Collector's Edition here!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/ab4de554393a7359eaf6c03cdf8725565c5d782a.png
The Standard Edition of The Art of Northgard artbook will be available within the month of June. You'll be able to get your copy on the biggest distribution's websites as Amazon (and FNAC and Cultura for France) and independant libraries (only in France). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/70fd7e94173d29eb2a88a630828e14e2c4ead7e5.png
 We hope that you'll enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed developing it, we're incredibly excited to see some of the ways you will all customize your territory and to hear how you all feel about Northgard's latest (and definitely not last) update.

And of course, let us know your thoughts on the Official Northgard Artbook!

Shiro Games

notes.title: Balancing Patch (December 2020)

Your units regenerate health {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png during a feast {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png .

Health {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png [strike]75[/strike] ⇒ 70

SwirlAttack
Dragonmen sometimes execute a mighty swirling strike that damages all surrounding enemies.

Cooldown [strike]0.5[/strike] ⇒ 0.8
Secondary target damage coeff [strike]0.8[/strike] ⇒ 0.6




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fe698f047b23e10c641c6e0704738e1bec596b79.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1c6aca2a43c6e1488cea1ba8586a464044c3072d.png


Building’s window has been reorganized

A new toxicity report system has been implemented

A progression circle has been added above the calendar to show feast {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png duration  (disabled by default)

We hope you all enjoy this update and have a great holiday season!

notes.title: Brundr & Kaelinn, The Clan of the Lynx
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/ebafa968de3202cfd52aa11b26d6c9edfd3c346a.png


Led by Mielikki, the Beastmaster, the Clan of the Lynx have an exceptional connection with nature. Proud Hunters, their excellent archery skills and unique luring technique are more than enough to ensure the ongoing prosperity of their people. 

The Clan adopted the graceful but threatening lynx’s Brundr & Kaelinn when they were just cubs, who now serve as the eyes of the clans esteemed leader and a force to be reckoned with on the battlefield.


https://j.gifs.com/k8vwZJ.gif


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e5f02db21fe6dd8c0335a961c92d16a14d60b545.png
Earn Hunting Trophies on animal kills.
You can summon Brundr and Kaelinn to your Training Camp. Mielikki the Beastmaster is weaker than other warchiefs but does not cost iron.  
The Archery Range replaces the Axe Thrower Camp. The Trackers they train are ranged units shooting a wide variety of arrows. 
The Path of the Hunter replaces Military Paths. Spend Hunting Trophies to unlock powerful abilities for Brundr, Kaelinn and the Trackers.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/61a24ab25a2b0f38d3e3bbd6a0d072fa83735935.png
Lure (200{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png)
Unlock Mythical Lure for Mielikki. She can place a lure in a non enemy controlled zone, which will periodically attract Mythical animals. They come in higher numbers as time passes. 


Oskoreia (500 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png)

Unlock the Oskoreia ability for Mielikki. She can recall the last and strongest Mythical animals the clan killed. In their spirit form, they come back for a last rampage on earth. 




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9dd4b887e93827b8ec887a9d66e81a3e8bc395d5.png


A fierce huntress in her youth, this proud and capable leader now rules the wildlife of Northgard and sees only through her faithful lynx companions eyes. 

While her advanced age may limit her effectiveness on the battlefield, she more than makes up for this with her unrivalled command over the wildlife that inhabits these lands who will fight for her and her people without hesitation.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b8d47a7025242c048c3c53687c4f280b7213c2b2.jpg




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f3e551e85b3a1047f1f606140771611e521f2cb0.png


The faithful companions of Mielikke and loyal servants to the Clan of the Lynx.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c46b06c9b45ebb5b8b211813504fa62c73828538.jpg

Brundr is the youngest and more playful brother, and while he may look like an innocent cat, you should never underestimate his fearsome swipes and prowess in combat.

The experienced elder of the two Lynx, Kaelinn has seen a lot and seeks to protect his younger brother and the people of the clan from the dangers that the land of Northgard presents. 


https://j.gifs.com/ZY1gq5.gif




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/33d8fd4c7fe10bb4b3c1eacbcb31f7969defe0fa.png


Place a Trap in a non-enemy zone. Activate on demand to reveal spikes that damage and slow down the enemy as long as he stays within. Last 30 seconds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/146d1af72d9320877e9edd207125c446410ba8d5.jpg

https://j.gifs.com/yoj597.gif




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/11180a34d6f7df483b72be260647bdd5649e5126.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/dc340f767fc967f4cbf1e2faf40b3c5be93a285d.png
The next Feast’s {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png cost is reduced by 5% (up to 50%) per animal you clan killed. +2 Happiness {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png during a Feast {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png . Also give one free Silo upgrade.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/cb82a2dd3fb9c71ff0494ae815067cefbd47c95a.png
Defense Towers are equipped with the Tracker’s arrows you have selected in the Archery Range.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/baf02a25d48a691b2d703b4ff0552390effca45f.png
Lynxes frequently leap and dodge every attack while airbone. Gives Brundr and Kaelinn +35% max life{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/06d3bf79dec0beaba207205d7909a3998010f7f5.png.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5db353f56f1c7b75beeda0c3926b5d0917496408.png
Mielikki can place one additional lure at a time. Oskoreia spirits gain +20% Attack Power {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9f1986148a58aa976c2ac94a51d9f313b68b5d5f.png .


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/001046fcb0a6e6782b644f7a28b168d6fa6be6c8.png
Unlocks Trading Routes at the Trading Post. Allows you to sell Hunting trophies in the Marketplace (2:1 ratio). Merchants produce +15% more Krowns {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png .




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/eb6caac35a1ca4d40d627df227fb2972cd73fb9f.png


When taking on the Lynx Conquest, the Clan of the Lynx gets specific Conquest-only bonuses:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f5c3769419d9814b9c1f2531c8740a5bd0a02e6f.png



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/196a0ccb4f106190dcb3c0d8b4ad798eb873839f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fe30b6b27b3694d67996a5f92f49d1a13d97eb02.png



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/d2d07ec5908b0a81a4a394944d4adc65ec760e77.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3ad891b6e4ad2aba1fd97c662f3844fd7ca488e4.png
Win with the Clan of the Lynx [not in Story Mode].


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1c51904f210a120aba42e748df98704262f918aa.png
Achieve 50 Victories with the Clan of the Lynx [not in Story Mode].


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/81a1e1bf38825744f8d2a798272a60faa30e5fc6.png
Reveal an enemy Townhall with Brundr or Kaelinn [not in Story Mode].


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e262dce451c337119ded98e3193c4c5c0e322a58.png
Trade 500 Hunting Trophies in one game [not in Story Mode].


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a584b1a3e897d3cf96bfed100be0c862084b3dbc.png
Release Oskoreia at the highest level of threat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/8cdbc374f10b75ae6df82a2944c9608751e4fe39.png
Build the Relic of the Clan of the Lynx.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/80e47491485bc263d45d9a6bc8a83d871b6cc7c8.png
Finish a Conquest with the clan of the Lynx.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/73770271111c14a1432f1e99d11d4024c0d75056.png


[NEW]  Korean language is now available on Northgard.
[NEW] Server zone for Asia. 
[NEW] Northgard is now compatible with Asus Aura keyboard.  Aura provides a nearly endless spectrum of colors, patterns and the ability to link lighting to Northgard in-game activity.
[NEW]  New music ‘Angst Of The Unlighted’ has been added to the game.
[NEW]  Sound design for Militia.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/113ee4fdffb6e5d6edb1a3db0b2454d19923b31e.png

[NEW]  Cooldown icon has been added above Ancient Graveyard.
[NEW]  Option menu has been improved.
[BUGFIX]  In “Create new game’ menu, “Advanced options” has been corrected. These options were reseted after each new game. 
[BUGFIX]  Clicking on a unit’s skill no longer removes the health bar.

Lifebar

Lifebar UI has been improved. Getting an affect with a lifebar icon (ex: BloodBath) forces the display of the lifebar for the duration of the affect.

[BUGFIX]  Lifebar icons no longer appear above the blizzard effect. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/31f5e35edfb00408c557e1c9b52b86d3fffbcb50.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3b8f037b26208cc6dd59774ecb0c2a9acf9f9b27.png
• Mimirsbrunn is no longer a "consumable": if a player has already recovered his tech, another player can now take the tile back and seek his own tech.

• A player must own Mimirsbrunn  if he wants to benefit from the tech he has chosen. If he loses Mimirsbrunn, he must take it back to benefit from the effect.

• Each player can choose their own tech, the tech is not related to Mimirsbrunn.

• Mimirsbrunn button in the lore tree has been moved. 


JORMUNR RELIC 

[NEW]  5 colonized zones gives [strike]+1[/strike] ⇒ +2 lore {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png production.


• [REWORK] Ranged units no longer try to find a place at max range of their targets (especially Watch Towers) if they are already placed and in range. In general, groups of ranged units should try to place themselves a bit smarter around the field.

• [REWORK] Attack speed and animation-based damage calculations have been cleaned up and rewritten to standardize the results for all cases.

These changes affect:
- Slows: Different slows no longer stack, only the strongest current slow is taken into account and correctly affects the target's DPS.
- Ranged units: Had a different way to calculate their attacks' damages, which resulted in DPS changes with attack speed.

• [REWORK] Ranged units' delay between chained attacks was reduced and correctly taken into account for damage calculations
These changes should allow ranged units to attack faster but only once they started shooting.

notes.title: Balancing Patch [JULY 2020]
notes.content:
Hello Vikings!

Today, we’re releasing a comprehensive balance patch designed primarily around feedback and suggestions posed to us by the community since our last balancing patch back in March. We’ve made a number of major changes and even introduced some new mechanics with this update and you can see everything we’ve been working on below!

WARNING! 

Please note that we have introduced a backup system for the game progress save file. As with any new system, there is a risk to lose your progress. Please make a copy of any files starting by "stats_" contained in your "save" folder.

REMOVED [strike]Converts all civilians in the area into Militia. They can’t go outside of your territory.[/strike] 

Call to Arms is a passive ability placed on your Town Hall. Every six months, homeland sends you 2 Militia to help you defend your territory. Militia is a self-sufficient unit that patrols within your territory and attacks any incoming threats. You can have a maximum of 2 Militia in your territory. 

Each kill on allied territory gives +100% Military Experience. 


Garrison
Now placed in [strike]first[/strike] ⇒ second position.

Each Defense Tower adds +1 to your maximum warband (+2 if upgraded).
