You gain 1 free Tower upgrade each year. 

You can have a maximum of 4 Militia in your territory.

The XP gain bonus of the guardian Path (which used to be on Garrison) no longer gives double XP to players that kill units of a guardian player on his territory.


Suppressing fire

Human units within an area that contains an allied Defense Tower gain +30% defense.

notes.title: Free Major Update: Northgard Map Editor
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!
We're really proud to finally present you the fourth major free update, and possibly the most game changing (no pun intended) yet, The Map Editor!

The Map Editor update stands as one of our biggest updates yet and whole new level of customization to Northgard, allowing you to create and modify battlefields almost limitlessly, populating your maps with buildings, resources, decorations and AI factions of your choosing alongside full control over the visual design and layout of the map.

With this update also comes an external tool allowing even more customization, giving you the ability to change the values of units or buildings (such as attack/defense power, health, price etc..) and write scripts to setup maps with certain units/resources or entirely new victory conditions.

And on top of all of that, the update also implements Steam Workshop support, meaning you guys can create, share, download and play (in both single and multiplayer) each others creations hassle free through Steam!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/26c0895eca06c03a15686d2561feea8aeee894aa.png

Here's some more information on what you can do in the editor: Modify maps from classic Northgard map generations

https://j.gifs.com/3QmPYp.gif

 Change the elevation and natural barriers between each zones

https://j.gifs.com/6Xp4zN.gif

 Add any buildings, decorations, creatures/AI of your choosing

https://j.gifs.com/yoWx76.gif

 Edit and customize the starting zones owned by the players

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b434d0e72320dfd0fb6e16c163b137d44ed06c31.png

 Add and edit the special tiles found throughout the map

https://j.gifs.com/4QnPKx.gif

 Paint the map with dirt, grass, forest grass and cliff rocks, depending on the biome you created the map on

https://j.gifs.com/5QoXVY.gif


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/dd1fdb0e3d15ee319f55553d9eb12059a861ee95.png

Mimirsbrunn:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5a2d752b3600b949decd8e56c020a1650cc5dde8.png

Allows you to assign a villager to become a runemaster and produce lore. They may also discover a new knowledge from opposing clans.

Udarbrunn:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fe0497abc1df9e5913ff27f2162bd6e09a33faf4.png

Provides a healing bonus to your healers and allows the use of the Cleanse ability.

Landvidi:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/f3d6b24dc9394f4fefd52097e255668e7d7a5fe6.png

Units inside this tile gain invisibility, making them undetectable from anyone outside of it.

Poisonous Swamp:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/be288b79bee389e9e02e933bb7c1c6f430392d92.png

Exudes a poisonous gas which hurts and slows anything that dares pass through it.

Naströnd:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0dc1ccbf0623711cb69e5f1b7123540fb6b8e1cc.png

Thick thorns prevent anyone but the most agile of warriors to pass though. They can be cleared by a scout, providing additional wood resources.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0447ca0cd92b42932158c0b27d9292ced235c010.png

With the external tool, you can:

 Change the values from units or building, such as attack/defense power, health, price etc...
 Write scripts to setup a map with certain units/resources or add new victory conditions.


You can find all of the necessary information for the best use of this tool HERE


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/df06dbf33207e5838a920062c22fcad807a963fc.png

And that's not all, as with this update comes full Steam Workshop support, so once you're able to upload your modded maps on steam workshop, download community created ones and play them all with multiplayer support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/37ba9d75dadbac8f86357e54615c6a55cc4bbf40.jpg

Please be aware, that the Map Editor is currently in "Beta Phase" so you may experience some bugs/quirks or crashes during use, however we aim to identify and resolve any outstanding issues as quickly as possible, so please please inform us of any problems you experience via our forums or Discord! 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3fffce435125716f31e25a12d4639dd876bcab2f.png

We know that creating mods can represents some issues, for that we created a full documentation where you'll be able to find tutorials and some answers to your questions. Click on the link to access to this documentation! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fa75d0959aa9a592660b1c0e860d6b66d2e6c33d.png



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/5ee16b2d2c831a3fa79d35961a3b2fb92027a6a5.png
[previewyoutube=XZ7zi91Jmas;full][/previewyoutube]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6bfaebf70914697f6b6ebc4de203bd53f3d37ee5.png

In addition to the new map editor tools, we have also made some small changes to the game, details of which can be found below:  Steam users can now play multiplayer with GOG users (And vice versa)
 New tiles introduced with the editor can be found in non user generated maps


We hope that you'll enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed putting it all together, we're exceptionally proud of the map editor and can't wait to see some of the cool creations you guys come up with!


Stay safe,

Shiro Games

notes.title: Winter Festival Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/78d64d953141c57788741bcf209e493df56729b1.jpg

Hey guys! The Winter Festival is here and it comes with A TON of cool changes! The game’s balance has been completely redone, and we truly hope you’ll have even more fun playing Northgard :-)

I. It’s the Winter Festival again!

 Permafrost is the default biome during the winter festival.
 Villagers can build snowmen
 Giant Trees have winter decoration.
 Axe Throwers throw snowballs
 Some Deer have red nose.
 Bears on Permafrost are white


II. General Changes

1. Lore Related Changes 

A LOT of different Lores have been modified to make the game more enjoyable and intuitive to play:

 Trading lore doesn’t exist anymore. 
 Shipbuilding now allows the Lighthouse.
 Coinage now allows the trading routes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/57c70c2488ed77739744e23d2a23f84884459736.png
 Mining Efficiency is now at Tier I in Wealth Tree, replacing Trading
 New Mining Efficiency:  +50% speed mining. No more additional ore.
 Eradication becomes a generic Lore, no longer a Stag specific lore. It is a Tier II in Growth Tree, replacing Mining Efficiency.
 New Eradication: Silo bonus +10%. -50% upgrade costs. No more happiness bonuses.
 Recruitment is now triggered when sacrificing a Dragon unit or slaughtering a sheep or a giant boars
 Medecine : +50% healing speed (no more Healers can bring food when they do not heal). 
 Military Strategy get a max set at 25%


This patch will introduce two new Lores that fill holes in some of the clans potential. These will grant us more flexibility when balancing the game or designing new clans:

 Tier IV in Growth branch ⇒ Shiny Happy People: -20% required happiness based on your population
 Tier IV in Wealth branch ⇒ Trading Caravan: Trading Route gets +20%. Affinity with neutral factions grows quicker


2. General Relic Related Changes

 Mjolnir: does less damage during a shorter time.
 Skull of Hrungnir: gets a 1 year cooldown and you can summon more than 1 zombie giant.


3. Miscellaneous Changes

Coming with the rework of the Lore tree, the following changes will help balance things up:

 Healers can bring food when they do not heal. No need for Medicine lore anymore.
 The Townhall provides +1 krowns.
 Basic Mining speed has been slowed down.
 Skirmishers are no more accessible to all clans. They are exclusive to the Snake clan.
 New tool for Scouts: +15% scouting speed, run between territories
 Forge building cost is reduced: 60 wood, 15 krowns, 30 sec build time
 Spectral warriors and Myrkalfars can be found in any Biome, not only Ragnarok.
 New Altar of Kings:  +3 Food / Wood / Krowns / Lore, +1 happiness, 50 fame
 Supply lines penalty decreasing with time -5% per year
 There can be more than one Bear in a zone, depending on difficulty and Townhall distance
 We added a cooldown for the first recruitment of the Warchiefs (This includes Kaija, but not Signy).
 Projectile Resistance is now an ability.
 When playing in multiplayer with or against AIs, it is now possible to have an infinite pause. 
 You can keep exploring a Ruin or Shipwreck an ally started to explore without starting over.


4. Neutral Faction Changes

A few things have changed regarding the Neutral Factions behavior to give them a fair impact on the game:

 Trading with neutral factions improves trading over time.
 Trading with them prevent them from attacking you (works with Kobolds and Myrkalfar).
 If you have a positive relationship with a neutral faction, they won’t attack your territories.
 Blain gets the thunder attack, like the Raven's Giant Mercenaries.


III. Clan Balancing

notes.title: Northgard Conquest
notes.content:
https://j.gifs.com/wV2NOX.gif


Hey everyone!

We're really proud to finally present you the third major free update, and the biggest one yet: Northgard Conquest. 

Northgard Conquest is a standalone game-mode that can be played solo or co-op, with a succession of various challenges offering a gaming expansion of +100 hours. The difficulty of the co-op mode will be based on strong collaboration between players. 

Forget the lore, choose your clan and let's fight!





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4a22535db3211deaf4c2ee9631c00eab9f62e9ec.png

Northgard Conquest offers you the possibility to choose your own experience when facing the harsh challenges of Northgard Conquest.

https://j.gifs.com/ANWZ2l.gif


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9c761f3d17b249ce0e65da69a7598add3b9ff5f5.png

If you want to challenge yourself and personalise your Clan with unique bonuses whilst counting on your own skills and decisions, then choose the Northgard Conquest solo-mode, defeat the other clans and claim the Throne. 

Believe in your strengths, establish the best strategy, exploit resources in an optimal way and build the most formidable clans to endure Northgard’s relentless hostility!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/cebb554507e7ee96f1c5c846ca31720ecc19da7c.png

Another addition is the ability to share your adventure and overcome the harsh obstacles with the power of collaboration in the new Northgard Conquest co-op mode. 

Northgard Conquest encourages teams to experiment and discover every combo available in this game-mode! But beware, Northgard Conquest is a cunning opponent! Having two in a team means double power, double bonuses and of course, double the problems! But nothing is impossible for fearless vikings.

Plan a global strategy, divide the tasks, collaborate, and master the continent together!





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3c1fe28805cba1b376745ae537ab666ba8b0bae1.png

Northgard Conquest introduces a brand new way to present and organize all the different challenges Northgard Conquest offers: The Conquest Map. 

https://j.gifs.com/lxXo4j.gif

The Conquest Map is formed by several challenges, 3 of which are specific to each Clan (and adapted to their specialties) which remain constant. The other challenges are pulled from a random pool of challenges, which means that if you restart a Conquest with the same Clan, you will get a different map with different challenges!

As soon as you succeed in one of the 3 specific challenges, several different paths are unlocked and the choice of which path you take is up to you.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/77ead56b278dba7dee7cc4f14e61a750b9ecc0df.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b569f44067e830e4f9fcc3163961cc0c375aa9d3.png

Conquest challenges are completely independent between themselves and will challenge you with various specific victory conditions and rules for each challenges. Here’s some examples:


Too Many Wyverns:
Victory condition:

- Kill 3 Wyverns. 

Special rules: 

- Lots of Wyverns are spotted, it's time for a hunt!
- Town Halls are already protected by updgraded Watch Towers. 

https://j.gifs.com/lxXoJ5.gif



Race to Yggdrasil:
Victory condition:

- Find the legendary World Tree Yggdrasil, and be the first to conquer it. 

Special rules: 

- Yggdrasil is larger and cost twice the price to colonize. 
- There is more Fishes, Fertile Lands and Deer in the map.

https://j.gifs.com/4QVZPV.gif



Kobolds Infestation:
Victory condition:

- Gain enough territories and raise your Fame {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png to obtain the title of King. 

Special rules: 

- Many Kobolds {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1d422ee8b3f8a4210ee45b9393bc5a4a41727756.png camp everywhere. Kobolds {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1d422ee8b3f8a4210ee45b9393bc5a4a41727756.png are more aggressive, respawn and expand quicker. 
- For each decolonized Kobolds {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/1d422ee8b3f8a4210ee45b9393bc5a4a41727756.png territory, earn 10 Fame {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png . 

https://j.gifs.com/2x2ZAz.gif




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/54bbc6badbe60b6c8132fd10b07b7b746dd21115.png

As you progress through your Conquest, you'll get to choose specific favors to power up your clan and help you win the next challenge (applicable only to the Conquest game mode). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c0c9db0c37a865c39a2d4b9caa304c7610bc4c7e.png

You can obtain these synergizing favors at the start of a Conquest! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/fe9487e6e1464bc8771b4c6279100bef5d47d925.png

And if you succeed in beating the entire Conquest of a Clan, you'll get a marvelous Town Hall skin related to it! You'll be able to use these skins in all modes:


Clan of the Bear / Boar
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/0d898946a564b6fa1509dde511ad37d5e2e7925d.png

Clan of the Goat / Stag
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/006add7921e990061a959f4fdc04359cb0986704.png


Clan of the Dragon / Raven
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4083165b8b2e7e72fd892ff170af1319261cbb5c.png


Clan of the Snake / Kraken
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9da826b3c303e716e70b535b675aa629d54fb64b.png


Clan of the Horse / Wolf
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/95aab2dc1d8795a64d62c12cb4b5de2dd7b3f023.png





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a1dce6fa97dbabb9c86c23b7ae045e0ce668c97f.png

As the biggest major update yet, Northgard Conquest also includes a variety of specific elements as special units, buildings, resources, events or maps. During challenges, you’ll need to exploit them as best you can to succeed!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a750f8c22166f3b1700a7c07c8cae855f1c021b4.png

Valdemar The Cursed
Valdemar was a Legendary King who died bringing battle to Helheim. He now wanders Northgard’s land to avoid death and reach Valhalla. He is usually surrounded by a group of Dark Vaettir who will not let you reach their King. 

https://j.gifs.com/jZ5wkv.gif


Dark Vaettir
Unholy Ice Spirits that should not live on this side of Bifrost. 

https://j.gifs.com/gZ89w3.gif


Undead Wyvern
A Frightening Beast, unnaturally turned into something even more terrifying.

https://j.gifs.com/WLp9MQ.gif



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/00fbcbc037538964bab7d25d3a4469e4f067d15e.png

Gemstones
Valued resources coveted by overseas merchants. 

https://j.gifs.com/ZYvBq6.gif



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/271bb6ba0c51e72460968aa5aad0806dd2dc5b38.png

Gates of Niflheim
Ancient and mystic gates that bring Death from another time in Northgard every Winter… 

https://j.gifs.com/vlRMk5.gif


Pillars of Glory
An ancient legacy for famous Kings. Assign Heralds to Pillars of Glory to earn Fame {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/516d994f7adb40efaa535c6ce32762e9592d1f16.png for your Clan.

https://j.gifs.com/WLpJ9v.gif



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/b701a77c3a920d7302597efe7e486715752bca95.png

Supply from Homeland
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/3bbc893781d50d7893819896d0c9d96dfb2d25e3.png

Boats {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e52a01ba7284e88f25327769604a030dac8bf209.png coming from Homeland will frequently bring you new Villagers to reinforce your Clan. 

https://j.gifs.com/WLpErJ.gif


Mercenary Raid
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/9add782f2cdbc0d3c1af9407dfd99d0cc4616311.png

A mercenary ship {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/e52a01ba7284e88f25327769604a030dac8bf209.png could been spotted near your coasts. You must prepare!

https://j.gifs.com/r8BGxE.gif


Curse
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/4edf20420d2b88e5f8963d908ed56831b2a059c9.png

Some of your units will be infected by a strange disease...

https://j.gifs.com/k8BxxE.gif


Frozen Attack
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6ebffc735bf9cc35ec660a690b8371005b418be0.png

Death is coming...

https://j.gifs.com/NLX6J2.gif


Sons of Hymr
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/a8409d8121f2cb9b98336e70feb51e1a8dc1aa5e.png

Some strange gates are glowing, prepare to fend off the invaders!

https://j.gifs.com/XLqGEk.gif



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/aea38abb4c53fb5bae2d2a4b3c424b731a2f0ea3.png

Northgard Conquest introduces new specific map configurations that you'll be able to explore during challenges, like The Inner Sea. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/704dc79edab814ff59e57eb0b31daa039b5a3491.png

This brand new map configuration will host challenges that encourage you to establish the best strategy and exploit all the available resources to succeed and conquer. 

https://j.gifs.com/L70pmA.gif




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/6917158e23f7d34e854f38607a70dd569811bd26.png

In addition to the basic difficulty modes (Easy / Normal / Hard), Northgard Conquest has introduced most challenging difficulty yet: Extreme Mode.

This difficulty will do everything in its power to stop you from reaching the Throne and will make Northgard an incredibly hostile continent, more so than it ever was.

But if this difficulty  isn't challenging enough for you... maybe we create an even more difficult one that will make Northgard a true nightmare for you!




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/c5570d976aede8f9480850b37a359043bd5a1308.png

The arrival of Northgard Conquest marks the beginning of a new Multiplayer Season: Conquer the region and ascend to the top of the leaderboard by taking the Throne on your own!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25920479/cbce036d51631a7a15fa3e2ddb5e7d3e104623e5.png

notes.title: News from Gamescom!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We were at Gamescom last week (in the business area), and we had a lot of exciting news  that we shared with journalists that we want to share with you today!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/20917ff2b1a1f38b72c200df8726356fe1a15cc8.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/021ba97d15142e8437cfff9669cb499f6058a5cc.jpg

First of all, this was the first time that we've had a booth of this kind of quality, and we were so proud of it! This is why we would like to thank you guys for making Northgard a successful game and for participating in the growth of Shiro Games

It's so satisfying for us to see that our work is paying off, and it's at this kind of event that we see the evolution of our beloved indie studio. 

This is only the start of the Shiro Games adventure, and your support drives us onward. So that's why during the last few months, we prepared a lot of new exciting content that we hope you will enjoy as much as we enjoyed creating them. 

Let's start with the news!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/20917ff2b1a1f38b72c200df8726356fe1a15cc8.png

Northgard Conquest

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f119b22bc8706dfba928ced0db97692887427776.jpg

We know that you were waiting for the next huge update of Northgard, and it's coming! 

We're proud to present you the 3rd major free update, and the biggest one: Northgard Conquest. 


Forget the lore, choose your clan, and let's fight!


Northgard Conquest is a standalone game mode that can be played solo or co-op, with a succession of various missions offering  a gaming expansion of +100 hours. The difficulty of the co-op mode will be based on strong collaboration between players

The missions are completely independent between themselves and will  challenge you with specific victory conditions and rules for each mission.


Challenges examples

 Valdemar the Cursed:

 Defeat a powerful boss in an undead infested land.


 Winter Has Come:

 Permafrost map with blizzards every winter.


 The Uprising:

 Ragnarök map with numerous and very aggressive Myrkalfars.




These missions are completely adapted to the strengths of the clans, which means that you'll get adapted missions depending on if you start the Wolf's campaign and then the Stag's one.

As you progress through your conquest you'll get to choose specific rewards to power up your clan and help you win the next mission (only work in Conquest mode).  If you succeed to beat the entire campaign of a clan, you'll get a marvelous Townhall skin you'll be able to use in the online mode.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/039a833f0dc1992728eed6146c2bd2c78a3ea095.png

Northgard Conquest is planned for Fall 2019, you'll get more information about it very soon!



Northgard Consoles Version

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/5d9cc4304b2126388e36a34808eab01c1b1ffb75.png

We're glad to announce you that our beloved Northgard will be available on consoles (Nintendo Switch, PS4, Xbox One) from the 26th of September on digital edition (you can already pre-order it on the Nintendo Eshop), and then on physical edition! 

Additionally, you'll be able to get a physical Signature Edition of Northgard, which includes:  

 The region free copy of Northgard
 An art Book
 The soundtrack
 An art Card
 A certificate
 Two Metal Pins


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/691cc78566d5da6b29cf09543a0c37cb89089d90.jpg

Click here to get more information about it!


The consoles version of Northgard includes a brand new control system that allows you to do all the in-game actions in an ergonomic and instinctive way: The Dynamic Control Wheel.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/6765687de4e2055793832e65ee6852c793b308ff.jpg

Consoles version content

 Solo mode
 Campaign
 Coop and competitive online mode 
 6 clans
 Ragnarök and Relics updates 



Northgard Uncharted Lands

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/cb8380d2be2dbc8d0762d2f2c4b1dbe138604f4a.png

Finally, we're proud to announce the boardgame version of our beloved game: Northgard Uncharted Lands!

This boardgame is the faithful adaption of Northgard, and as the video game, you'll find similar game systems on the boardgame version. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d39594821aa4efd3d6e032a9d98efcc659e137ae.png

Caracteristics:


 Play time: 25mn / Player

 Actions system:

 Move,
 Attack,
 Recruit,
 Build,
 Move,
 Explore...


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/eb2f17adbc04c6d9ff35c813da4c2eadc1b7f328.png

 Harvest system:

 Gain Food,
 Wood,
 Lore,
 Fame,
 Trade resources...


 Seasons system (Summer / Winter)

 Deckbuilding system (add a new card to your deck)

 Tile laying system

 5 clans available with specific starting powers:

 Wolf,
 Bear,
 Stag,
 Goat,
 Raven


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a7efea2f3c95c962024851c9abac2dda3cd0540f.png



Components:

 Viking models and unique Warchiefs models

 Modular board tiles


 Over 100 cards with unique effects

 Special Viking and Warchief dice

 Resource tokens and building tokens

 Creature Models:

 Wolf,
 Bear,
 Valkyrie
 Draugr


 5 Clan boards



The Kickstarter campaign will start Fall 2019, We'll have more to come soon!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/20917ff2b1a1f38b72c200df8726356fe1a15cc8.png

And that's all! 

We hope that you enjoyed reading this and are excited as we are!

This is only a preview of this news, you'll be able to find all the details soon. 

This is important to us to thank you again. Without you, Shiro Games is nothing! Be sure that we're working on so many huge and different projects that we can't wait to share with you!

Stay tuned for more information, and have a good time on Northgard!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9ebc232deca26973725e0d10a4786bb4f0a7b3b2.png

 Thane : Future Sight - https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png 200

 You are warned of events long before they happen.
 You gain 400 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png


 Jarl : Howl from the Sea Master - https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png 500

 Whenever you kill military units on enemy or neutral zones, they have 10% chance to become Spectral Warriors under your control (max 5). Spectral warriors bring https://i.imgur.com/UXcSad9.png to the zone controller.





https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e16f9353281c939558a256db3c295f030ea8d6ee.png

The clan of the Kraken introduces its exclusive units:


 The Norns try to elucidate the will of the Kraken, bringing foresight and good fortune to the clan. They produce https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png and https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png.

 Wielding divine power, the Valkyries are the most powerful members of the Kraken's army. Your clan can only control one at a time.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/99441616a4b0201ce99277ba9f7a53e59c40db94.png



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a4b4ce56b94e025486837cd2a1a7e79f4d1e245e.png

The Fishery is an exclusive https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png generating building for the Clan of the Kraken. This building can be built on shores and beaches. You can assign 2 Villagers to this building to transform them into Fishermen (3 Villagers if upgraded).

https://j.gifs.com/6X007R.gif



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/56280edba936720c81195d5bf0c41b962e9ec0de.png

The Hörgr is the second exclusive building for the Clan of the Kraken. You can assign only female villagers to this building, transforming them into Norns. You can assign 2 of them to this building (3 if upgraded).

https://j.gifs.com/819973.gif


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1b0e069e2ec74c2450cc8809f87b84ceab789f60.png

https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png is a Kraken Clan's exclusive resource. It can be spent to activate special abilities. The Clan of the Kraken starts the game with 400 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png and a passive production of +1 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/8293b5a0798e0bf6bc292872f4177eb999355216.png

Shallow Waters - Costs 100 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png

https://i.imgur.com/CkftgRp.png

 Improves a coastal zone to accept one additional building.

High Tide - Costs 300 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png

https://i.imgur.com/45xETH9.png

 You can only cast HighTide on a non-coastal zone adjacent to non-coastal zones or zones affected by HighTide.
 This cancels the Kraken's building and attack penalties.
 You can colonize this zone at the normal cost.



Road to Valhalla - Costs 600 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png

https://i.imgur.com/uJqPv4a.png

 Consecrate one of your Norns.
 She becomes a Valkyrie and joins your army.
 You can control only one Valkyrie at a time.


The Valkyrie is one of the exclusive units of the Clan of the Kraken.

https://j.gifs.com/Qn5A2G.gif


Ancient Spirits - Costs 1 000 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png

https://i.imgur.com/SxHZ568.png

 Summons 5 hostile Spectral Warriors to target enemy's coastal zone.


https://j.gifs.com/D1wxM5.gif



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/8e5d411dedceed57cd80d9ad8f22d3fb9a24df49.png

The Clan of the Kraken has 5 exclusive lore:

Near the Sea Spirit - Replaces Trading

https://i.imgur.com/EOSy2Iw.png

 Generates +1 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png every 3 buildings on coastal zones.
 Enables Trade Routes with Trading Posts.



Endless Tide - Replaces Weaponsmith

https://i.imgur.com/p29lfFh.png

 Reduces the cost of military units by 20%.
 Each military camp gives +1 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/7e6b1ccaa5d706595bcd116dd25f37b434fc289c.png.
 Gives +20% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png to military units.



Knowledge from Beyond - Replaces Shipbuilding

https://i.imgur.com/tXzqNoW.png

 Reveals all neutral factions.
 Trade routes with neutral factions earn you 20% more https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png.
 All Trade Routes give you +3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png.



Fresh Fish

https://i.imgur.com/uv4m7hA.png

 Fishermen produce 20% more https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png. 
 Their tool improvements are free and their forging time is reduced by 2.



Foresight

https://i.imgur.com/khHUgz4.png

 Norns generate 20% more https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png and 50% more https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png.




https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/bcd1da31ab855d1bf5b6f7f332dee73cad033433.png

The Kraken clan has its own Relic, the Edda of Vör. Given by Vör, wise and curious, so that no one can hide anything from her.


 This Relic allows your Norns to earn https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png.
 When the Relic is built, it gives 1 000 https://i.imgur.com/BIHBgO0.png.


https://i.imgur.com/ystjXSN.png



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/5cf342a6a2dc5a7b6c7b865161ed5869eaf1dfdf.png


 The Valkyrie’s weapon gives +10% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png. 
 After forging the Valkyrie’s weapon, they gain the Purify ability and can sacrifice themselves to instantly colonize a neutral zone or an enemy zone being uncolonized 
 Cooldown: One year


https://j.gifs.com/vlmxz5.gif



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/de176beea3136022a9e703f60da5bc9368b804af.png

The Kraken itself roams around Northgard and punishes those who do not fear it. The Kraken attack lasts for 3 month, sinking boats and damaging ports. 

No one can survive the attack of the Kraken.


 This event is not linked to the presence of the Clan of the Kraken.




https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/c35dafede18ba8802ed36fa12da1e151be39084c.png

Statistics
We've added various statistics to the end game screen (via a new View Statistic button). 

They will show:

 Production
 Usage and changes over time for many resources
 Population
 Military units
 ... and more!



Clan of the Snake

 Stolen Lore can steal "Knowledge from Beyond".



Achievements

 Day of the Tentacle

 Win with the Clan of the Kraken [not in Story Mode].


 Kraken Master

 Achieve 50 Victories with the Clan of the Kraken [not in Story Mode].


 Victorious Squid

 Witness a boat sunk by the mighty Kraken.


 Fresh Sea Air

 Win a game without colonizing any non coastal zone.


 Pride of the Kraken

 Build the Edda of Vor [not in Story Mode].




Balancing & Bug Fixes

 The Warrior bonus versus Shieldbearer decreased from 15% to 10%.

 The “Deer Hunter” achievement is fixed.

 [Bear] Hibernation: Doesn’t heal sick people anymore.

 The Giant Boar has a trigger warning when uncolonizing.

 The https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png production of the Sailors has been decreased by 20%.

 Now all maps will always have at least one neutral faction.

 The Fallen Sailor event now can appear in every game, not only in Ragnarök.





https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/db55c6a734485223e28bb6d21e3201767c484a69.png
https://youtu.be/XDvErtua6v8


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e74744ac1fe18a66c49349728c0615b2e30f9f99.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1088640/Northgard__Lyngbakr_Clan_of_the_Kraken/



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1af217f13a13159bf3d5522c182dd514fd0d839e.png
We hope that you enjoy playing the Clan of the Kraken! 

We still have a lot of awesome content coming in the near future and we can't wait to share more with you. 

Release the Kraken!
https://i.imgur.com/qy0pLMz.png

Ohoï Warchiefs!

Clan of the Stag

 Food Preservation
Increased https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png production by [strike](+2)[/strike] +3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png for each silo, and [strike](+4)[/strike] +5 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png if upgraded. 

 Glory of the Clan

 +20% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png on https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png gains.

 The Value of Great Deeds

Clan of the Goat

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1661b250fc6c12e7cebc8453408f57c4ad7d6e39.png


 NEW - Shepherd -  formerly Cooking Mastery

 2 free Sheep.
 +10% Sheepfold production.

 Sheepfold

Clan of the Wolf

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/13c36fa7f6a513fb52d0ebc3be6149e9c57eff7a.png


 Starting bonuses

The larger your army is, the less https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png per Warrior you’ll get.


 Veiled Threats

 +75% if you have a Berserker.

 +1% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d80f134a6dc707a6cc2cd0114f073d0158ca4328.png and +1% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e7c2fec2a1b00e46f5d824e031ac55bbdf0d75e6.png per merchant or sailor (max 15%).

 Fame 500: Mercenaries

Clan of the Bear

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9c10eaf8e2f98bbb46beabc9294078de0f59a8b4.png


 Starting Bonuses

Clan of the Boar

 Herbalism

 Lay of the Land

 Frequency of attack from Wolves and Draugrs: -70%.

 Osmosis

Clan of the Snake

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/3bce93eadcae8745c680882866655ac572a00cfc.png


 Stolen Lore
Choose one clan-specific Tech of another clan from the following list:

 Field Rations (Wolf clan)
 Industrious (Goat clan)
 Food Preservation (Stag clan)
 Journeymen (Raven clan)
 Harpoons (Bear clan)
 Legacy (Boar clan)
 NEW -  Dragonic Frenzy (Dragon clan)
 Ancestral Influence (Horse clan)


 Age 18, Rite of Passage : Scorched Earth

 Ruins & Shipwreck give +2 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png.
 Special zones bonus is doubled.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a25fabb94f0f9c3125f5298475d12e8cd0b32ad7.png


 Starting bonuses

 NEW - When a Dragonkin is recruited, he is entirely healed up.

 Dragonkin

Clan of the Horse

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a90f503e1033fe4c70d214519b044b515006cf66.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/6ec1e3c1c314c1f96bfa5feed8136e12e7c8869d.jpg

 -50% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png cost.
 Your units regenerate https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/0830b639988f38f2b33a27963f119ea993eb1853.png Health during a https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/fcfad8cc35dd15c209c6e2c0e7b1c716c0eb9ee4.png.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d131389a76d833c9e16fd674906039f0aaaf5a95.jpg

notes.title: Viking RTS Northgard adds giant-summoning Relics and more in big free update
notes.content: Developer Shiro Games' entertaining Viking-themed real-time strategy, Northgard, has just received a major new content update - introducing, among other things, powerful Relics that can grant serious benefits to your ever-beleaguered clans.The free update, appropriately titled Northgard Relics, is described by Shiro as the "biggest content update" since launch. Unsurprisingly, the focus is those game-changing Relics, with each clan able to choose between five common Relics and one clan-specific Relic, although only one can be used per game.Common Relics grant the likes of defence bonuses, feast bonuses, and more for the duration of play - which, while supremely useful, are considerably less spectacular than the clan-specific Relics. These are able to summon such wonders as mercenary giants, massive boars, the undead, and white wolves to do your bidding, which - I think we can all agree - is far more exciting than having a couple more apples for your tea.Read more

notes.title: Northgard gets game-changing relics in a free update
notes.content: Viking RTS Northgard received a meaty update today, introducing powerful artefacts that can buff your clan. They're accompanied by an expanded crafting system, along with changes to tool mechanics and the forge, which is where your smiths will be working away to make your fancy relics. It's live now. Just by luck, the vikings have remembered how to craft these relics, and each clan can pick between five common and one clan-specific relic, activating one at a time. With these handy artefacts, you'll be able to summon giants and undead monstrosities to do your bidding, just like the old vikings. Inside the updated forge, you'll be able to put three smiths to work, letting you craft items quickly. They can upgrade civilian and military tools, and it's now possible to queue up multiple items. The smiths can be upgraded, too, giving them a boost in forge speed.It sounds like a good excuse to return. It's one of my favourite Age of Empires-style RTS romps, and some of these relics sound like proper game changers. 50 percent defensive bonuses, colonising tiles with lore, summoning the wrath of gods—they're not messing around.Take a look at the patch notes and relic list here.

notes.title: Northgard Relics - the Open BETA begins!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We've been working hard in the past few months to improve the game offer you some exciting new content!
Here is Northgard: Relics, the next major update for our game!https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/8c21ab3d3b6eaf256dcef1d04b569709d9abca5e.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/35c321d36812af8724ec0aea4f29ed0f9cf72307.png

This BETA's primary goal is for us to determine if the Relics change the game in a positive way and work as well as they should. 

The Beta will run for 2 weeks (until March 14th). We'd really appreciate it if you'd share your feedback with us on our official Discord (in the open-beta channel): https://discordapp.com/invite/northgard

How can I join the Open BETA?

It's very simple:
Fill in this form: https://goo.gl/forms/t7KWaQZkuVxaYdPu1
Get your Open BETA code at the end of the form
Right-click on Northgard and go to Properties
Jump into the BETA Tab
Enter the code
In the drop down menu, select Open Beta Relic
Quit and restart Steam
Northgard should require an update!

Congrats! You're in!

You can find the full patch notes below!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9575a5b32409f6eb1eec990ff43db1469ec77335.png


The creation and usage of tools has been completely changed in this patch.

The forge

The Forge has gained a lot of importance in Northgard. The building requires a Woodcutter’s Lodge to be created and costs 80 Wood and 20 Kröwns.
The building can be upgraded with 100 Wood, 50 Kröwns and 5 Stones.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a7569124d4b2c260d48335011cd9f3a7a1bf5b26.jpg
You can assign 2 smiths to a non-upgraded Forge and 3 to an upgraded Forge. Add Smiths to craft items quicker.
You can build more than one Forge, but you won’t be able to use both buildings to craft the same item.

The tools

In the forge, you now have the possibility of 3 different actions:

 Upgrading civilian tools
 Upgrading military tools
 Forge a Relic

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/7c03ce7a85d2113dbaf998c8a563337400260d59.png
You can queue multiple items in the Forge. When the first item is finished, the Smiths will start forging the next one.
If there isn’t any adversity in the Forge’s tile, you can cancel the creation of an item, and you’ll be refunded its original cost.

You’ll have the possibility to improve the Smith’s tools, granting them a 15% increase in Forge speed!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1cf6109e26cb4bef3df446d4255e2681e1392e75.png


The knowledge of building Relics has just been rediscovered. Every clan can choose between 6 common Relics and each clan has one specific relic. Each clan can only have one relic at a time and only can use the relic it creates. 

To build a Relic, go to the Relic tab in the Forge menu and select the type of relic you want to build. Once it’s built, it will appear in the list of available buildings. Forging a Relic costs 10 Iron, 50 Wood and 100 Kröwns.

notes.title: Update - Northgard Winter Festival
notes.content:
Winter Festival

Today sees the citizens of Northgard begin their Winter Festival. This brings with it plenty of holiday cheer, a brand new map and a new event.

https://j.gifs.com/W72Bro.gif



New Map - Permafrost 
Brave the elements and get into the Winter Festival spirit with this all new snow covered map. 

New Event - Frozen Sea
The Frozen Sea event will cause the Sea of Northgard completely freeze over. A thick layer of ice completely blocks the harbour, making it impossible to navigate, obtain resources, organise raiding parties or buy Thralls.

https://j.gifs.com/D9BEOk.gif

We’d also like to wish every one of you a happy holidays! We are truly thankful for your continued support and will continue to improve the game even more in the coming year https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png .

notes.title: PATCHNOTES - Clan of the Dragon
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/926dfdc0cd0b816ad105eda91cbc89ee8386f45f.png



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/80c1ee85b734a1ff8bd03d619f868205e270506f.png

Description

The most alien of all clans, the Dragons follow ancient customs and embrace sinister traditions. They use sacrifice and slavery to further their goals, often earning the other clan's distrust.

https://j.gifs.com/mQARDp.gif

Starting Bonuses 

 Your civilians can go into neutral territory.
No Happiness or Production penalty for being wounded.
You start with a Sacrificial Pyre. You can build a Dragonkin Altar instead of other military buildings.
You start with 2 Thrall and 3 regular Villagers. You can buy Thralls from your Longship Dock 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9e8fdf13e0c9f8053da8ea66d772f7a8fb762f2c.png

Description

Slavery is an important part of the clan’s economy. Like the regular civilians, Thralls can travel in neutral territory and fight.

https://j.gifs.com/voNqAm.gif

Thralls do not count towards your population https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/24d07f4169730eab1acf8bcc48ec09b63321038a.png and do not require housing. Their maximum number (https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/76e5ab45a9f133b282928e526a3a5143b1436d68.png) is based on your current population number: 33% of current populationhttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/24d07f4169730eab1acf8bcc48ec09b63321038a.png.
They consume only 33% of what a Villager usually consume and they gather 50% less resources than a civilian.

How to get new Thralls

There are 2 different ways of getting new thrall:
You can buy them from your longship dock. the price of each thrall will increase after each purchase (+40 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png) , and this price will slowly decrease over time (-2 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png/month).
After getting the Capture Lore, you’ll be able to enslave enemy civilians. You’ll need to get them to 33% HP to have a chance (10% chance per hit) to enslave them. This also works for neutral factions. Please note that each enslaved Kobold will take 1 slot in your Thrall population https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/76e5ab45a9f133b282928e526a3a5143b1436d68.png, each Myrkalf will take 3 slots, and each Jotunn will take 5 slots.

Thrall are a powerful economic and military asset but beware of their number! If by any chance your regular population falls under your Thrall population (if https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/24d07f4169730eab1acf8bcc48ec09b63321038a.png < https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/76e5ab45a9f133b282928e526a3a5143b1436d68.png), they will rise against you!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d72c1044ffd105357ce0f158c0e3a3cadc33c616.png

The Clan of the Dragon starts each game with a pre-built exclusive building: the Sacrificial Pyre. Through this building, you’ll be able to send every unit you have (except warchief, Jötnar and Bláinn, spectral warriors) to be sacrificed to honour the gods and gain their favours.

https://j.gifs.com/9QlyND.gif

Sacrificing a unit will earn you some Dragon Essence that can be used to unlock various bonuses:
Sacrificing a regular (non Thrall) unit gives 2 Dragon Essence Units (https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/c40434ba7d70eae4729e6581b331e71bc19f025d.png)
Sacrificing a Thrall gives 3 Dragon Essence Units (https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/c40434ba7d70eae4729e6581b331e71bc19f025d.png) 

Each Fame step will improve the available bonuses and will unlock additional parts of your Dragon Essence gauge.

https://j.gifs.com/86k26r.gif

The different bonuses that can be unlocked are:
Nanna’s Influence: +2 in https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png (Thane: +3 / Jarl: +4)
Andhrimnir’s Influence: +2 in https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png production (Thane: +4 / Jarl: +8)
Niorun’s Influence: +2 in https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png Production (Thane: +4 / Jarl: +8)
Njörd’s Influence: +2 in https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png Production (Thane: +4 / Jarl: +8)
Mimir’s Influence: +2 in https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png Production (Thane: +4 / Jarl: +8)
Hönir Influence: Your https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png slightly increases over time
Idunn’s Influence: Will heal your Dragonkin, wherever they are (if not in combat)
Magni’s Influence: +10% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png for your Warband and non-thrall units (Thane: +15% / Jarl: +20%) 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/6c5097135149ab042266f31d06f5035238a85445.png

The Clan of the Dragon does not have access to the regular Military Building. The only military camp you’ll be able to build is the Dragonkin Altar. Each Altar increases your warband size by 1 (2 if upgraded).

https://j.gifs.com/kZyQYx.gif

Giving a Villager his Dragonkin form is a non-reversible process and will consume 50 Krowns (+10 per new Dragonkin) and 1 Dragon Essence Unit https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/c40434ba7d70eae4729e6581b331e71bc19f025d.png.

Dragonkins are ferocious military units, more powerful than warriors.

Thanks to the Frenzy Lore, they can get a +50% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png bonus when fighting alone in a tile.

https://j.gifs.com/596nBx.gif


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/30b444737c7db6bf0431d9ab9a7280157ee8f6e6.png

The Clan of the Dragon has 5 new Lore: 

Hard Labor: Your Thralls can be conscripted to production buildings to increase their output (You can assign a maximum of 1 Thrall)
Blood, Sweat and Tears: You can assign 2 extra Thralls to production buildings. (You can assign a maximum of 3 Thralls)
Capture: Gives a chance to enslave wounded enemy civilians or neutral faction units. Enslaved Myrkalfar count as 3 Thralls, Jötnar count as 5 Thralls.
Slave Trade: Thralls are cheaper by 50% and minimum price is also reduced by 50%
Draconic Frenzy: +50% https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png for a Dragonkin with no other ally unit in their zone. 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a280607942bae4926b2333949c38bd83e5d93173.png

Clan of the Wolf: The berserker now costs 200 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png and 5 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/17fc6dc587210ecfba331647c66a0b7c5b62e07f.png. His defense has been raised to 10.
Clan of the Bear: 
The Clan now starts the game with Kaija https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/27c75c2734a96fd1a50cc39a0c400cb9277be42b.png.
Fame 500: Kaija can now go into enemy territory
Clan of the Goat: 1 sheep has been added in nearby territories

notes.title: AMA Transcript - What's Happening in Northgard
notes.content:
Here's the transcript of what was said during the last AMA, hosted on Northgard TV by the very dedicated and talented Weihn8smann!

RAGNAROK

Question: Special victory conditions in Ragnarok Maps?
Shiro Games: Something that will be coming in the future. More info at a later date.

Question: Why are there 2 special objective tiles on the Volcano?
Shiro Games: This is a bug and we are working on fixing it.

Question: Why did we decide to use Ragnarok as the update theme since Ragnarok is meant to be the ‘final event’?
Shiro Games: During the development process Ragnarok always seemed like the theme we could really bring to life. It is also one of the better known events in Norse mythology.

GENERAL

Question: Are there plans to make military more appealing for the more Neutral factions like Goat and Boar?
Shiro Games: We don’t want every clan to be focused around military. We like to have some clans that are better at other things. We have updates coming that will improve how these clans play.

Questions: Will you Buff Raven?
Shiro Games: We are always monitoring clan balance and will continue to adjust things as we feel necessary.

Question:  Will there be certain animals in other clans like Kaija, armored bear, in bear clan?
Shiro Games: Yes for sure! More information coming soon!

Question: Will there be a clan based around befriending neutral factions?
Shiro Games: There will! More news on this at a later date!

Question: Can we have a defensive building where civilians can hide during an attack?
Shiro Games: We think this would be a great feature and has the potential to add another dimension to the gameplay, Trying to work out the best way of implementing a feature like this. 

Question: Can you look at the sailors not getting sick while they are out sailing?
Shiro Games: We’re on it. 

Question: Any advice on what to do against mercs from Raven?
Shiro Games: Upgrade your towers on the coast and have a few warriors to help out.

Question: There are some enemies in the campaign like fire/undead jotunn or the Giant Ice Worm, Do you plan to add them to the custom games?
Shiro Games: We don’t plan on it. We want to keep some of the enemies specific to the campaign to make them feel epic and special.

Question: Any chance of a LAN option?
Shiro Games: It’s not something that we are currently working on.

Question: Any plans to add barriers?
Shiro Games:  Similar to the defensive buildings question. We like the idea but we need to make sure the implementation would bring something to the game.

Question: Will there be a way point from town hall so newly generated villagers would go where we want?
Shiro Games: This is something we are looking into.

Question: How are bonuses stacked? Is it multiplicative or additive?
Shiro Games: This depends on the bonus. Military bonuses are additive and generally the gathering bonuses are multiplicative.

Question: How are the numbers rounded in the game?
Shiro Games: Numbers will be either rounded up or down depending on the decimal. The rounding only affects the displayed number. The number after the decimal is the true value.

Question: Will there be more abilities?
Shiro Games: Yes we will be adding more abilities in the future.

COMBAT

Question: Is naval combat going to be a thing?
Shiro Games: Is not on the cards right now.

Question: Are any other micro related features planned? Build hotkeys, Ability to deselect individual units etc?
Shiro Games: We don’t want the game to become all about APM but we are planning improvements to the hotkey system and the unit selection.

Question: Will you consider adding more unique military units?
Shiro Games: We are! We’ll have more information very soon.

Question: Will you make combat units more complex?
Shiro Games: Everything is always evolving but we want to keep the core of what we feel makes Northgard feel unique.

Question: Will you introduce Siege units or buildings to break towers/tiles?
Shiro Games: This is not something we are currently working on but who knows what the future holds.

NEUTRAL FACTIONS

Question: Will you address the issues with the Ragnarok Kobolds?
Shiro Games: It’s something we are monitoring and we will make adjustments if we feel its needed.

Question: Will we see more natural factions/more animals?
Shiro Games: We’re working on it!

Question: Can we have the option to turn the tile back to neutral?
Shiro Games: It’s not something that we are currently working on but if we could see a reason/method for adding it then it’s something that could be possible in the future.

WORLD EVENTS

Question: Will we get new world events on the standard Northgard map?
Shiro Games: Yes! We have a few cool new ideas. More information at a later date.

VICTORY CONDITIONS

Question: Any plans on further tweaking the victory conditions (Particularly trade)
Shiro Games: A future update will completely change the way trading and the trade victory work!

Question: Any plans on some new special victory conditions? Do you already have some ideas?
Shiro Games: We are working on some new victory conditions and we have some really awesome ideas for the future!

NORTHGARD TRIALS

Question: Are we going to look into the ranked system and the problem right now with abusing win trading etc?
Shiro Games: We are looking into this and trying to find a good solution to the problem.

Question: Can we get a matchmaking system that takes into account the rank of both opponents and determines the glory point loss or gain based on that?
Shiro Games: This is something that we are looking into.

Question: Is it possible to not count GP when a game stops after a few minutes due to an AFK or a Leaver?
Shiro Games:  We are looking to see what we can do about this issue.

TECHNICAL ISSUES

Question: Will you please improve performance of the snake clans fire/burn ability?
Shiro Games: We’re working on a fix for this issue.

Question: Can you please fix the chat filter?
Shiro Games: We are working on improvements to the chat filter itself and we are planning to offer a function to completely disable the filter.

MISCELLANEOUS

Question: Will we get more colours for the clans?
Shiro Games: This is not something we are currently working on.

Question: Will we ever get a map editor?
Shiro Games: It’s something we have been looking into but we can’t make any promises on it right now.

Question: What about using Fjords instead of cliff to divide the tiles?
Shiro Games: It’s a nice suggestion and something we can totally look into.

Question: Are you going to introduce a cosmetic based ingame shop to purchase aesthetic items?
Shiro Games: We currently have no plans to change the monetization of the game or add an ingame store.

Question: Will the Draugr ever become a playable faction? Will we ever get anything other than Vikings?
Shiro Games: It is something that we would like to introduce in the future but we need to make sure that it fits in with the rest of the game.

Question: Do you plan on adding the option to save a multiplayer game?
Shiro Games: This is not something that we are working on.

DEVELOPMENT FOCUS

Question: Are you working on a more in depth diplomacy system?
Shiro Games: It is being worked on and we plan to include it in a future update.

Question: When is the next clan going to be available?
Shiro Games: It’s currently in development! We’ll have more news for you soon.

Question: Will you make new gamemodes with more challenging PVE functions?
Shiro Games:  We like the idea and it’s something that we are looking into.

Question: Will Northgard ever support Steam Workshop mods?
Shiro Games: It’s something we are currently looking into.

Question: Are you ever going to add more god related tiles or events to the game?
Shiro Games: We’re looking into it.

Question: What’s going to be the focus of your next big content patch?
Shiro Games: We’ll have more news on the next big content patch at a later date! For now we just want everyone to continue to enjoy Ragnarok.

Question: Any sort of API planned?
Shiro Games: This is not something that we are planning.

Question: Will there be more DLC?
Shiro Games: Yes. We’ll have more news very soon.

Question: Are you planning on making even bigger maps?
Shiro Games: No. We are happy with the sizes currently available.

Question: Will we get a continuation of the campaign? Will you ever introduce coop missions?
Shiro Games: Right now we are not planning on continuing the campaign any further. We are looking into some kind of co-op options.

Question: Will we get a replay system or post-game statistics screen?
Shiro Games: This is not something that we are currently working on.

Question: Can you talk about the future of the monetization system of the game?
Shiro Games: We have no intention of changing the games current monetization system. We plan to continue to release frequent free updates and some paid DLC.

Question: How many developers are still working on Northgard? How long until development stops?
Shiro Games: All of the core Northgard team are still working on the game. There are still 10 developers working on Northgard. Any new projects Shiro take on are handled by new teams. We have no intention of stopping development on Northgard anytime soon.

Question: Are there plans for new maps?
Shiro Games: Yes for sure! We have a lot of great ideas for new maps.

Question: How long should a Northgard game last?
Shiro Games: As long as it takes!

Question: The last update was incredible! What can we expect in the future?
Shiro Games: We have a lot of really awesome things planned for the future of Northgard and we can’t wait to start sharing some of them with you!

VIEWER QUESTIONS

Question: Will Warcry be changed?
Shiro Games: We monitor all feedback regarding specific abilities and will make changes if we feel it’s needed. We are currently looking into Warcry and may make changes in the future.

Question: How often can we expect ‘big’ updates?
Shiro Games: We try to have a bigger update every 3-4 months depending on a number of different factors. 

Question: Where can i buy Northgard Merchandise? 
Shiro Games: You can find Northgard merchandise here: https://shop.spreadshirt.fr/shirogames 

 Thanks for reading this :)! You can also find the VOD on our Twitch channel Northgard_TV. If you have any questions about Northgard and its development, I strongly advise you  join our Official Discord

notes.title: [PatchNote] Northgard Major Update - Ragnarok
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a16ad34b29089266fd2b0bac6bccf0e2ff743a73.png

Greetings Warchiefs!

We're glad to finally present you our new major update: Northgard Ragnarok!
Ragnarok is the biggest content update since the release of Northgard, and we truly hope you’ll enjoy what we’ve introduced :-)



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/33fd7ce1124e2bcf265e6a003e34d215dbc947bf.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/3275da482baff0073b23b92de1a62fb5c45f7bf6.png

The map you’ll be playing on when choosing Ragnarok is completely devastated. Your path towards your opponents may be guarded by dangerous creatures! The center of the map is occupied by a new special tile: the Volcano. We also added a new music for this map!

https://j.gifs.com/nrpXZY.gif
 
The earth has been ravaged, you won’t find any fertile spots to build your usual farms. Fish and deer will be the only available food source!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/2a7d61bc41bdb7d6cd1837a669d3e1262df3ff87.png

The Volcano

The Volcano is one of new tiles introduced in Northgard: Ragnarok. It is a special tile that cannot be tamed or colonized. During the game, the Volcano will erupt hurling molten rocks across the map. Some of them will land in your territory where you’ll then have the chance to mine them.
If you manage to completely mine these rocks within 4 months, you’ll be fine. If you fail, Rock Golems will spawn from them and attack the clan members occupying the tile.

https://j.gifs.com/Xo8W2A.gif

The number of Molten Rocks falling onto your territory will vary depending on the number of tiles you have colonized. If you didn’t manage to finish mining the rock before the deadline, the Golem will spawn missing a few HP.
Golems have Damage on Time attacks, that will burn their aggressors for a few seconds.


The Blood Moon

The Blood Moon is another new random event that we’ve added to the game. It increases the attack of all units outside of their territory by 50%! 

https://j.gifs.com/yrLjv7.gif

The choice is yours: will you take the risk of going out when everything has gone wild?

The Ancient Graveyard

The Ancient Graveyard is another new tile introduced in Ragnarok. You’ll have the possibility to assign two Lore Masters to study the Graveyard, gathering lore. Once you’ve completed the Graveyard study, two Spectral Warriors will join your army!

https://j.gifs.com/PZvlj2.gif
To the trained eye, it’s obvious that Seidr, an ancient form of sorcery Freyia taught the Æsir, was practiced here.

Spectral warriors have very high defense and are not easily hit by projectiles. They will be very useful to help you clear your surroundings of any enemies. However, because vikings are highly superstitious, your clan’s happiness will be reduced by 10 as long as they are in your territory!


Fallen Sailors

During their long journey toward Northgard, countless Viking ships have sunk into the great depths. But Ragnarok is here, and the Fallen Sailors return to haunt the living.

https://j.gifs.com/Ro3NyR.gif

“Fallen Sailors” is an event that can occur at any time during a game. You’ll need to deal with ghost Warriors attacking your shores. As seen previously, they have very high defense, and as long as they are in your territory, they’ll lower your happiness by 10.


The Kobolds Update

Kobolds now have a much more developed behavior:
Starting year 2, when the number of kobold reaches 7, they can send 4 of them towards an adjacent neutral tile and colonize it
They start with 1 tile and can have up to a maximum of 4 tiles under their control
If there isn’t any neutral tile close to their territory, they may attack a player’s tile
On neutral tiles, they do not fight wildlife but build their village around it!
They cannot colonize active Wolf Dens or Draugar Camps nor the other neutral factions’ tiles


The Myrkalfar

The Myrkalfar are the new neutral faction of Northgard. These dark elves are particularly aggressive and are strongly opposed to your presence on their continent. Every year, they’ll launch attacks against random players. Once they’re in your territory they’ll start stealing your resources, and you’ll be dealing with a -5 in food, wood and krowns.

https://j.gifs.com/zKGO1m.gif

To counter their attack, you have two seperate choices:
You can attack their camp, getting some of the stolen resources back after killing the last of them.
You can trade precious resources with them (stone or iron) and befriend them so that they’ll be more likely to launch attacks against your enemies.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/96553c2caa713221b9b970d5c91bae45b6b51e83.png

The Ragnarok update adds a new military system: the Military Paths! Every enemy defeated on Northgard will grant you xp points. When reaching  500 military experience, you’ll get to choose between 3 different military branches: The Tactician, the Guardian or the Conqueror.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/87896a29bb63d42c68b5fc8386f2d3e89db36ad3.png

Each of the Military Paths feature 3 different unlockable skills. Be careful: once you’ve chosen a path, you won’t be able to change it, so planning will be very important!

The third and last level of each path should be quite hard to reach as it requires a total of 3000 xp (500 for the first one, 1500 for the second).

Here are the details for each of the Military Paths:

The Tactician
