notes.title: PATCHNOTE - Clan of the Snake Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/926dfdc0cd0b816ad105eda91cbc89ee8386f45f.png

Ohoï Warchiefs!

Today, we finally bring you our first clan update since the release of the Boar Clan! But first, let's go through the changes we made to the game! Please note that you won't need to get the Clan of the Snake DLC to get these changes!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/708a6660191c88594d46272d6d7f21e9b29e7715.png

This patch introduces a new melee military unit available for free and for all clans: the Skirmisher!

https://media.giphy.com/media/QOxq2bHHwaPLygr6vn/giphy.gif

Skirmishers are very special units that can travel all around Northgard! In neutral tiles, they are invisible to wildlife and their movement isn’t limited by the presence of adversity..
You can choose to attack wildlife whenever you want by right clicking on a Wolf, Draugr, etc...

https://j.gifs.com/APzLMP.gif

They can run faster than other units (+20% movespeed) but be careful: the Skirmishers’ armor is made of light leather and they are more vulnerable than the rest of your army!

You can recruit Skirmishers through their Skirmishers Camp. This building is a basic military building, you do not need to have a Training Camp to build one. Skirmishers are the cheapest military unit.

https://j.gifs.com/VPq8N5.gif


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/ece648826f02b4a4c2e003f612208d1eb2d4592f.png

https://media.giphy.com/media/7TqA6qMCIdnCOPavSc/giphy.gif

Coming with this patch as a DLC, the Clan of the Snake will add a new way of playing Northgard. Lead by Signy, the Spear Maiden, Svafnir’s followers are among the most roguish vikings on Northgard!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/46c0c7cec6fc7c66ff5c2c9700d985fd6c0e2939.png

No Honor, no Fame

Unlike other clans, the Snake’s progression isn’t reflected by the Fame they’ve reached. Cunning and deceitful, the Snake has little regard for fame or honour. Members of the clan prefer working in the shadows and using guerilla tactics rather than open warfare. Its pride depends mainly on its warchief, Signy, who is already available at the beginning of each game. During the game, Signy will grow up and gain new abilities:
Age 15: The Cunning (start of the game).
Age 16: Pride of the Clan. Signy is now more powerfull, she gains 20% move speed and the ability to attack at range. 
Age 18: Tears of the Earth. Again, Signy’s power is increased, she gains the ability to walk freely among Northgard’s wildlife (like Skirmishers) and she can use her special ability: Scorched Earth.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/35dc7dd4680575a9072b94063b66fa64bafe654c.gif

If she falls on the battlefield, Signy will be available for rehiring in the Skirmishers Camp for 150 Krowns (no Iron needed).  
In terms of battle statistics, Signy starts with a light advantage in comparison with a basic warrior. She will get stronger and stronger with every passing year.

Her Scorched Earth ability will prove itself to be very useful. Signy charges to the center of a tile (any tile except for TownHalls and Victory Tiles) and prepares herself to scorch everything around her. After 5 seconds, Scorched Earth is launched:
Available every 3 months
Effect lasts 3 months
If the effect is cancelled during Signy’s preparation time, there is a 1 month cooldown
Signy cannot be interrupted by anything other than the player(and her death of course)

Scorched tiles have the following effects:
+50 attack power the Snake’s units & buildings
-50% for any production in this tile

The Snake's Lore tree

As most of the other clans, the Snake can acquire specific knowledge:
Black Market replaces Coinage: 
Merchants produce +10% Krowns
Gain 75% more Krowns when trading with enemy clans, degrading diplomatic relations. 
You can trade even when at war
Enemy clans get no ressources from Black Market trading
Rapacious Exploitation is the ultimate Lore of the Wealth branch: 
Bonus of special tiles (Geysers, Thor’s Wrath) is doubled
Ruins and Shipwreck in your territory grant +2 happiness
Under Pressure replaces Weaponsmith:
+20% attack power for Skirmishers
+2 happiness and +2 food for each enemy pressured by the Snake 
An enemy clan is pressured if one of the Snake’s military units is on an tile adjacent to or inside his territory
Guerilla replaces Military Strategy: Military units gain +2% attack power per enemy civilian killed (max 40%)
Stolen Lore is the ultimate Lore of the Ressource branch: Steal a Lore from another clan’s tree:
https://media.giphy.com/media/g0jZ1uKZdMmGoy7vLd/giphy.gif


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/ee7ce018a6cef5e73297850993c4a80052b0d0f7.png

The arrival of the Clan of the Snake in Northgard forced us make some moficiation on the curent clan balance. Here are the changes!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d15632ed693142ef4ee29a2a060b776be7b812a0.gif

General Lore Modification

Recruitment now gives a 25% bonus (instead of 30%). This rate is increased to 50% during 6 months after the death of one of the player’s unit
Sharp Axes bonus has been increased to 20%
Defensive strategy bonus has been increased to 30%
Monster Slayer bonus has been increased to 50%
Negotiation bonus has been increased to 50%
Legendary Heroes now gives +25% attack power and +25% defense to Warchiefs



Clan of the Wolf

Fame 200 is now Dominion, with a cooldown of 12 months
Fame 500 is now Advanced Assault: +15% attack and reduces Dominion cooldown to 6 months
We added an animation when using the Dominion capacity
Field ration bonus has been increased to 80%
Plunder healing has been reduced to 30% of the unit’s max health
Veiled Threats bonus has been increased to 75%


Clan of the Bear

Harpoon bonus has been increased to 25%
Winter festival now reduces the food production loss by 50% during winter and grants +3 happiness


Clan of the Stag

Great Deeds now gives +2 krowns per active skald
Eradication now also reduces the cost of upgrading silos by 50%


Clan of the Raven

Journeyman max bonus has been decreased from 8 to 6 happiness


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/ce94b632eaf3d3eead110a0e34a7fe8e6d95604f.png

We also changed a few things with the Victory Conditions:

Fame Victory

The food required to colonize new tiles has been increased
The number of tiles required to win Fame Victory has been changed:
Small & Medium map: 12 tiles
Large & Huge: 14 tiles


Lore Victory

The Lore requirement for later techs has been increased


Trade Victory

Ships now bring ressources to the player when reaching certain steps:
500 Commercial Influence: 100 Wood, 100 Food, 50 Lore
1000 CI: 150 Wood, 150 Food, 5 Iron
1500 CI: 200 Wood, 200 Food, 20 Stone


Yggdrasil Victory

Food required to colonize Yggdrasil has been lowered from 2000 to 1500 food
Colonization now takes 6 months


Gates of Helheim Victory

Players now have to defend the gates of helheim during 8 months



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/ab2d034cb8a0675948c59d9971df37bf4f74ae02.png

We changed a few general aspects the game, adding a few things you asked:
Ruins revenue scaling is now based on the distance between the ruin and the closest ally Town Hall
Draugar, Valkyries and Kobolds had a (very) small increase of their HP.
The AI now has better military micro management
It is no longer possible to destroy a building in a tile occupied by military units
Warchiefs no longer consume food and do not use a population slot
There is no longer a cooldown when slaughtering sheep
You can now press “x” to stop your selected unit’s current action
There is now an option next to the chat window that allows you to mute channels and/or other players (does not affect pings yet)
Every villager now has its own name!
The Story Mode chapter completed with all secondary objectives are now distinguishable
The Profile tab now displays information about the player’s progression in Story mode
The Berserker and Signy’s abilities are now located in their description window

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/7bae213da0f724e77025d52b3e823cd278bb49db.png

Finally, a few modifications about the Ranked system:
Balanced maps are now available on 2v2v2v2
A player who hasn’t been able to connect to a game won’t lose any points
In the lobby, players cannot change teams when the timer has started


We trully hope you'll enjoy playing with the Snake! As we mentionned before, this clan and the new features are just the beginning of a lot of new features that we cannot wait to add to the game :)

We'll be back very soon with news about the next update, which will change a LOT of things in the way you fight in Northgard ;)

Have fun!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/b3deeaa80479cf4487c0e4f85dd348640f2d29d7.png

notes.title: A closer look on Signy, the Spear Maiden - Clan of the Snake Release Date: 19th of July!
notes.content:
Ohoï Warchiefs!

We thought we'd share a few details about the upcoming Clan of the Snake and more precisely on its exclusive Warchief: Signy, the Spear Maiden!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/ece648826f02b4a4c2e003f612208d1eb2d4592f.png

Coming with this patch as a DLC, the Clan of the Snake will add a new way of playing Northgard. Lead by Signy, the Spear Maiden, Svafnir’s followers are among the most roguish vikings on Northgard!

https://j.gifs.com/ZVB1zv.gif
                                                Signy, the Clan of the Snake's Warchief

Unlike the other clans, the Clan of the Snake’s progression isn’t reflected by the Fame they’ve reached. Cunning and deceitful, the Snake has little regard for fame or honour. Members of the clan prefer working in the shadows and using guerilla tactics rather than open warfare.
As a consequence, the Clan of the Snake does not get any Fame from its actions in Northgard.

 Its pride depends mainly on its warchief, Signy, who is already available at the beginning of each game. During the game, Signy will grow up and gain new abilities:
Age 15: The Cunning (start of the game).
Age 16: Pride of the Clan. Signy gains move speed and the ability to attack at range.
Age 18: Tears of the Earth. Signy gains the ability to walk freely among Northgard’s wildlife (like Skirmishers) and she can use her special ability: Scorched Earth.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/35dc7dd4680575a9072b94063b66fa64bafe654c.gif
Note that each year, Signy will grow stronger and stronger.

The lore tree of the clan will be centered on its abilities to harrass and pressure other players.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/676d5e7b739f15a232440315c2611d3ecb7c58d4.png

As a reminder, next update will bring into Northgard:
The Clan of the Snake
The Skirmisher, a special melee military unit, available for all clans
Balance changes to the Clans and the Victories

IMPORTANT
The Clan of the Snake is a purchasable as a DLC, the rest of the update, including the Skirmisher, is a free update available to all players!

As our main concern is to be sure the community isn't devided, players who do not own the Clan of Svafnir will be able to play with and against players who do!

The Clan will be purchasable for 4.49€.
Finally, we have a release date for you: July, the 19th!

We trully hope you'll have a lot of fun playing with this clan! As we already mentionned in previous announcements, we still have A LOT of things to add to the game in terms of new Clans, new game mechanics, foes, neutral factions, etc...

We'll be back soon with more news! ;)

notes.title: [Patchnote] Northgard Trials
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/082bb8a6dadef11af3177a51941cfe9183992b72.png

Welcome to the Northgard Trials!
In this first update since the official release of the game, after overcoming the challenges and dangers of the colonization of Northgard with Rig, Halvard and the others, you’ll have to prove your worthiness and climb the ranks towards every Viking’s ultimate goal: the Rimesteel League!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1387259238

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/a73f25e98e961c16c3fd1f8f24f56728c78fa2ee.png

This update brings into the game a completely new ranking system:
In Northgard’s new Multiplayer menu, you now have the possibility to choose to create a “ranked” type of game (for the moment, only on dedicated Servers).
Ranked games always have every Victory Conditions enabled.
When winning a ranked game, you’ll receive Glory Points (https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png). The amount of https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png you’ll get is based on the rank of the other players in the game. The higher rank your enemies are ranked, better will be the https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png rewards.
We added a new Player Ranking page, which allows you to see your current rank and the result history of the  last 20 games you’ve played.
You’ll start in the Wood league and earning https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png will allow you to reach new leagues:
Wood League: 0 to 149 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png
Stone League: 150 to 299 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png
Iron League: 300 to 449 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png
Gold League: 450 to 599 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png
Rimesteel League: 600 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png and more 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d41ff8332ecb2fd0b04d4058106c81d232207d34.png

Every league will unlock a new aspect for your Townhalls (for both Single and Multiplayer games).
In a Ranked game, a disconnected player will be considered as a leaver if he’s not reconnected before 5 minutes. As a leaver, he will lose the ongoing game (with a https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/91498c8eae5a8d0c79b8f69d0edc3fc02612de9d.png penalty) and will not have the possibility to join any Multiplayer game (ranked or not) before 15 minutes.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1dc4cb7f451f51ca3918105d406df73b8ccf4bea.png

A lot of you asked for it, so we made it!
Huge maps are now available for Single and Multiplayer games. With larger maps come new game modes:
FFA - 8 Players
4v4
2v2v2v2
https://j.gifs.com/nrkJR7.gif
Disclaimer: The generation for these maps may take a few moments at the beginning of games. Low configuration computers may have some trouble running this type of games (especially in end game).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/713c5416f737074eac68805c6be938cb4c9259c7.png

As you know, we value a LOT the randomness of the map generation in Northgard. However, it seemed a bit unfair to allow the win and the loss of ranked games to depend in a large part on such a huge random factor.

In this update, you’ll have the possibility to choose to have balanced map generation! 
Here are a few rules about this map generation:
For the moment, balanced generation is only available for the following game modes:
Duel
2v2
3v3
4v4
2v2v2
Balanced generation is built by team (not by player).
Special Tiles and Neutral Factions are the only tiles that aren’t exactly the same in the two sides of the maps (if a team gets Thor’s Wrath, the other may have a Geyser).
Some specific clans will get specific positioning in the map:
The clan of the Raven will have the most access to shores
The clan of the Bear will have the most access to fish tiles
	
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/ab45e779360462d0a1c0dacac7dc33e6c17305f8.png

We changed a few other things in the game. Next patch will add some major changes in the balance of the game. We felt that with the arrival of the Northgard Trials, we should let you apply the strategies you have been practicing in the last few weeks. https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f228a220d7de01fbc7f84d097c262f4bed4e2de0.png

Here are the minor changes:

Warriors now have a damage bonus against Shield Bearers.
We changed the Gold income coming from trading with the Giants
Trade victory has been slightly modified:
You can now build a Lighthouse event if the Trade Victory isn’t enabled
Greater Trade Routes now grant +1, +3 and +6 happiness depending on the level of the route.


As a conclusion, I strongly advise the everyone willing to find other people to play with (or against) to join us on the official Northgard Discord Server!
Here is the link: http://discord.gg/Northgard

notes.title: Patchnote 1.1 - Happy Easter!
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

We’ve been working hard these past few weeks to fix the majority of the bugs you reported! Here is the complete Patch note for this update :-)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/db16d468493d3d082385cf76fa9539746ab96f7a.png

The ESC key now closes the chat window in priority
Trade Route will be stopped before reaching 0 Krowns (to prevent building from burning)
We added an effect on ongoing scenarios to help clarity of the campaign map. This should help new players understand their current objective!
We balanced a little some of the campaign scenarios:
Chapter V: there is now a clear sign showing when reinforcement will arrive
Chapter VI: answering one of Svarn’s request now also grants some happiness
Chapter IX: there were some text errors
We added the Turkish language to the game (sorry for the delay)
When entering an area with both an enemy unit and a neutral unit, the player can now kill the neutral unit before killing the enemy unit. This was abusively used by some players.
Once you finished a chapter at least once, you will have the possibility to choose to watch the first ingame cinematic

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/19adf6ea4364e576f98821f4a166349543e5bb19.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/557304188e7c2df71f0866b2718b95989346dfd9.png
After last patch, the Clan of the Raven became a little unbalanced, thanks to its ability to colonize territories with krowns. We changed a few things about it:
We increased the Krown cost of colonisation by 10%
The Raven’s Fame 200 now also grant 1 happiness

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9c7450fa81979d8b2b92c93b5edaec141e4a8757.png
In the Multiplayer game creation menu, we fixed a visual bug that caused the “AI number” line to switch place with the “map Size”
It is not possible anymore to upgrade the Gates of Helheim
When befriended, the Jotnar (on the Jotunn tile) won’t count as clan’s population
Scouts health bar sometimes disappears when scouting, this has been fixed
There is now a progress bar for the menders’ healing
We fixed a bug allowing trade routes to keep going even after reaching 0 food stock
When slaughtered by the Wolf Clan, sheeps will not provide gold anymore with Pillage
The Draugar Invasion alert sound has been added
Mercenaries in your territory will not count in wood consumption during winter anymore.
The “Hanging Out With Friends” achievement is now functional (so sorry for the trouble)
We fixed a wording issue with Fur Coats: it affect both civilians and military units
We fixed a Camera behavior bug when switching between military group of units
We addressed some UI issues 
We fixed NULL ACCESS errors

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f99b21f87f4829f02a2cd9f850f5d250af9337da.png
Thank you all for your support and reporting the bugs your witnessed! 
The next months will be dedicated to develop a new Multiplayer Ranking System with balanced map generation! A new clan will shortly follow this update ;-)

Happy Easter and enjoy your sheeps ;)

https://j.gifs.com/vo7O05.gif

notes.title: [Bug Fix] Patchnote 1.0.8796
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

Bug Fix

We fixed a few things that caused problems in the v1.0.8772
Crashes were fixed
Easy mode for Chapters 3 & 11 have been modified
French, German, Polish & Portugese translations have been fixed, Spanish & Turkish translation are still to be implemented
Games in campaign mode were counting as played game in the "Profile", they aren't anymore
Arrows, axes and spears were shot to the sky, it has been fixed
We changed a few wording and camera problems in some of the campaign chapters.
We fixed the non-functionning campaign achievements. To activate your achieivements, just play and win any other chapter in the difficulty level you did the rest of the campaign!

Other things to know

During the dialogues in the campaign's chapter, the game is paused, you can take your time to read everything, your units will not keep fighting ;-)
The MacOS version is now live and functionnal! If you encounter any issue on this version, pease report it in the dedicated thread :
http://steamcommunity.com/app/466560/discussions/0/1698293255121551686/
The Linux version of Northgard is yet to be optimized, and should be working soon on the majority of Linux Distributions. If your distribution is not compatible, an error message will warn you and give you the name of the libraries you'll need to download in order to make the game work properly! Here is the dedicated Linux Bugs & Issues thread: 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/466560/discussions/0/1698293255121560931/


Once again, thank you so much for helping us patching the game! <3

We're working on the other achievement and campaign problem you met!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/466560/discussions/0/1698293255121560931/

notes.title: NORTHGARD OFFICIAL RELEASE - RIG'S SAGA IS OUT
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

We’re so proud to finally officially release Northgard to you!! :)

Before jumping into the patch note, we really wanted to thank all of you for supporting our game during this Early Access year! It’s been quite a ride :)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/549904de75634714d7a17aaad9cf0a4d65edcb8d.gif

This major update is without a doubt the one we put the most work in. You’ll of course be able to enjoy the full version of Rig’s Saga. We also worked a lot on a new feature for our combat system, and we added A LOT of cool new things :)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/01d1205bd7142a368923f866e8ec653d83b455f8.png
As we reached the 20k users registered to our Rig’s Saga Beta, we knew that we had to deliver a very qualitative and fun to play campaign mode. We work very hard on these 11 chapters. I strongly recommend you to play the first chapter again, as we added new cool things (including Achievements, Easy and Hard mode, dynamic in and out game cinematics).

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1323083558

A few more things for you to know:

For each difficulty levels, completing the campaign will unlock specific Steam achievements
Completing every additional objectives for each chapter will also unlock Steam achievements
When having completed every chapter in Hard difficulty and having obtained every additional object, you unlock something quite special for your solo and multiplayer games ;)

We truly hope you’ll have fun playing this campaign =) 

Disclamer: We know that some of the campaign dialogue are still to be translated, we're on it, and it should be done next week! ;-)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/bc6620600c1102fa5e6f90fa481feae77ca7e78c.png
Mac & linux versions of Northgard

You asked for it, so we did it!
Northgard's Mac & linux versions will be released tomorrow, March, 8th :)

New Features - Solo & Multi player

Supply Penalty:

We know there has been some issue with rush tactics. So we decided to add to the current combat system a “distance to home” dynamic. Military units will have their attack power decreased depending on the distance their are from allied territory:
1 Tile: -0% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png
2 Tiles: -5% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png
3 Tiles: -15% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png
4 Tiles and more: -30% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/f4b13c7ead69a569086f4afc0f9574458f905bca.png
Please note that this rule will not affect mercenaries’ attack power and will not be implemented in the campaign scenarios.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/83aaa1d0ec9434eeee364bd244b1ae6c5cc417cb.gif

Other changes:

AI behavior has been modified: its aggressiveness will be scaled on how close you are to victory
Silos now can only be built on tiles where a http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png generating buildings are built. They now only improve food production of Fishermen, Hunters and Farmers
Feasts now grant:
20% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png production bonus for healers with Medecine
20% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png production bonus for Menders and Sailors
20% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png production bonus for Skalds and Sailors
Tool upgrades now grant
+15% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png production for Skalds
+15% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png production for Menders
+15% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/0ba4b3362ae8daab47fd64a8978d7c9ad435c3cf.png/http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png production for Sailors (depending on your choosing)
+15% http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png production for Healers
We changed the way villagers react to an attack in their tile:
Villagers who are building in a tile under attack will now run to defend the tile
Exception: villagers building towers will keep building!
You can now cancel the launch of a Mercenary raid by pressing the ESC button
The units of a defeated player will instantly be killed if they are situated in another player’s tile (ally and enemy)
You can now access the patch notes from the landing screen of the game
You can now travel to a healed unit by double clicking on their portrait
When decolonizing a TownHall tile, every member of your team will now earn some http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png
We added many alert boxes regarding the players’ progression towards victory in multiplayer games:
Reaching 800 and 1000 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/72f6ecfe84847a197be7ed2078882a2be9d66878.png
Colonizing the Relic of Gods
Colonizing Helheim
Reaching 500, 1000, 1500 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/856842b75f6e0b73cde677d3c182a876da4e1fe1.png
Colonizing the Magma Lake tile
When forging each of the Odin’s Sword peices
We added 8 new achievements related to Solo/Multiplayer games
We changed the way diseases work (again...)
We added more shortcuts, with the possibility to remap them. Here is the list of the functionalities:
Change minimap type, from ressources to military (T)
Select inactive clan member (U)
Select all villagers (G)
Select all scouts (H)
We added another mapping system for Bear clan. Select the Warband (E) and click (E) again to exclude Kajia
Affect only one unit (Ctrl (Hold))
Cycle through selection (Tab)

https://j.gifs.com/Q0KQvl.gif

New Features - Multiplayer only
You can know choose to play on dedicated servers or to host games - this has been added after many Australian players (among other) encountered lag issues, sorry guys!
We added a profanity filter on Multiplayer games
In the lobby, you cannot choose a team if it is already full

Cosmetic changes:

We added lightning during bad weather
We added trails for combat units movement. This adds a lot of clarity (and coolness) to fights!
We improved the FX of the Draugar Portals and Wyvern attacks
You can now choose between 7 different environment when creating a Solo or Multiplayer game
https://j.gifs.com/APXB7j.gif

Clan Balancing
Clan of the Wolf:
Pillage now also works on ally territory
Plunder healing effectiveness has been reduced (from 50% to 35%)
Clan of the Boar
Handiwork effectiveness has been increased from 10% to 15% for non-upgraded buildings
Lay of the Land now reduces the chance of being attacked by neutral units by 90% (previously 30%)
The Mender's Hut cost has been lowered from 60 to 50 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/6d9ba8ecaf0047819b6a081a00b9f21cd6de0908.png and its Krown upgrade cost has been lowered from 50 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png to 25 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e19d2d45ad0bdf4cf82f603aac466af240dbd2df.png
Clan of the Stag: Advanced Silo bonus went from +2 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png and +5 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png (when upgraded) to +2 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png and +4 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png
Clan of the Goat: You only get one sheep at the beginning of the game. However, at least one other sheep will ALWAYS be in an adjacent tile
Axe Throwers attack power has been slightly decreased (-5%)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/cb63db3d4e505bdc29fa566ad919ddb7ebb58cf0.png
As usual, we fixed many bugs:
Life bars of longships docks and harbors are now correctfully placed
Victory bars are now more logically scaled
We fixed an issue where sailors would spawn in the water once a player has lost its Town Hall
We fixed many visual problems with the Wyvern animations
We fixed a problem in the way the description of certain building was displayed
It was possible to walk through the Altar of Kings, this has been fixed
It it now possible to heal Vedrfolnir when given by an ally
We fixed a visual bug on the farmer’s food gathering animation
We fixed some issues with the tile transfer:
Towers will now have the right color
The notification “building not built” and “building empty” will now disappear
When launching mercenaries on Fields Tiles, you’ll get the right amount of http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/1392cc44146e6b96baed2004a1fcce187568ce14.png
When targeting a tower, military units will not walk through rocks and lakes anymore
The miner’s upgrade tool now gives 15% more Stones
We fixed A LOT of “No Entrance”, “Null Access” and “EOM” bugs 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/cf3f245a0580e449468ac28c88c488661fb2b409.png
The roadmap after the release

As we already mentionned, Northgard's development will not stop with this official release! We plan on working on the game much much longer, adding many gameplay features, game modes, and general content.

Between these MASSIVE updates, we'll keep improving the game, in terms of bugs, system compatibility and balancing.

In a few weeks, a balancing patch will be released to adjust the clans' specificities after the modifications of today's launch. Following this, we intend to work on a more complete multiplayer patch.

The next clans' release

With each of the major updates, we plan on releasing new clans to add to the diversity of the game. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/454507c369be9c320613bd15f89523eaa13bec6e.gif
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png Any resemblance to real months is purely coincidental http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/9420a41fe9e913f3b3b3162c067b650951006ac0.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/3b228b9ea808726308abea4d2f36a488b4aa47f4.png
The last year has been quite a ride for us! Northgard's concept seduced way more people than we anticipated at first, and you, as a group of players passionnate about Strategy games, pushed us to deliver the best game we could. We could not have dreamt of a more helpful and dedicated community and it's clear that Northgard could not have been as complete as it is today without you!

For that, for your invaluable feedback, for you advice and feature requests,we say THANK YOU! The future will show that we will not let you down.

Enjoy Northgard, its campaign, its solo and multiplayer modes.

https://j.gifs.com/L8GMjr.gif

ShiroGames Team 
 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/c88bbbd7d8b13ee4930875936dafc5e2a405fd59.png

notes.title: PATCHNOTE #20 - CAMPAIGN BETA
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

Today, we’re incredibly proud to introduce you to the first part of our Campaign mode! 


CAMPAIGN MODE - RIG’S SAGA

The first five chapters of Rig’s Saga are now available for you to test! As for the servers, you have the possibility to fill out a form, giving you access to a “campaign-beta” version of Northgard.

This BETA will grant you access to the first Act of our campaign! You’ll be following Rig, son of the Vikings’ High King. The High King is murdered and his REGAL HORN is stolen by a man named HAGEN.This event kickstarts a saga that will take RIG and his right-hand man BRAND through the new continent of NORTHGARD, where he will make new friends and foes and discover a much greater threat than HAGEN, and the reasons behind his father’s assassination.

Check out our Campaign Teaser:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1287486656
You can now fill out this form, and at the end of it, you’ll get the code to access the BETA!

At the end of the form, you will get a campaign-beta code, that will allow you to test the beginning of our Campaign :)
Once you get your code:
1- Right click on Northgard on your Steam library
2- Click on Properties
3- Open the BETA tab
4- Enter the code you received and choose "campaign-beta" in the drop-down menu
5- Wait for the Download of the update (you may have to restart Steam)
6- Start Northgard and enjoy the Bgining of Rig's Journey :-)

Any trouble, just follow our "How To" video!
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1287346407

Disclaimer: for now, the campaign is only available in English, but do not worry, it will be translated in many more languages :-)


DEDICATED SERVERS

The dedicated servers are now officially launched (they are now available on the "default" and the "campaign-beta" version)! The Beta we launched two weeks ago allowed us to identify and fix the large majority of bugs that were reported! This is all thanks to you! We had more than 4 000 participants to this BETA :D
=> As always, you’re the best ;-)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e4381334de4eb1c68c4a15b751c6278d42b85604.gif

Disclaimer: We currently have 8 servers at our disposition, each of them can host a few dozen Northgard games at the same time (more or less depending on the number of players in those games). 
As we carefully monitor the servers activity, we’ll be able to add more servers in case we are going under capacity. If the servers become too crowded despite that, you’ll automatically switch to the original host system as a backup!


UPDATE CHANGELOG

As always, we’re always trying to make the game better for you, and we changed a few things in this update too! This is available on the default version of the game!

Townhalls now harbor 6 villagers, increasing the maximum population when starting a game by 1.
Happiness is now display with different colors and texts if you’re over or under 3 http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d87f1a110236821425f45c82057fb7afecbc348a.png.
When going for Trade Victory, you’ll get the amount of Commercial Influence displayed in your resource bar http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/d5aec37d3c7bdafcc9addbc2ee2099fb47259746.png.
When trading with other player/AI, information about this whos is trading what with whom is now displayed next to their namehttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/be37b7b9fcea8891b8c950f63dc1a8975bfbd9c7.png.
When one of your ally is attacked, the Warning pop-up will now display “Your ally is under attack”.
When a Raven Clan launches a mercenary raid, every player having scouted the targeted area will now be warned of the launch of this raid.
We added Polish language translation (not for the campaign). Other languages will come for the official release.


As always, thank you so much for your support, you’ve been the best community we could ask for! We trully hope you’ll enjoy playing Rig’s Saga as much as we loved imagining it!

notes.title: DEDICATED SERVERS OPEN BETA & PATCH NOTE #19
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

We have exciting news to share with you :^)

DEDICATED SERVERS

We’ve reach the final stage of the implementation of our dedicated servers. During the latest tests we made, they seem to behave quite well. 
The next phase is to perform some stress tests, and to do this, we need you!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/8c4baa0883e2699806dac4f16d536ce0c30ddb27.gif

If you wish to enter the open BETA for the servers, just follow this link and fill in the very little form we prepared for you.

At the end of the form, you will get a BETA-Servers code, that will allow you to play on our brand new servers :)
Once you get your code:
1- Right click on Northgard on your Steam library
2- Click on Properties
3- Open the BETA tab
4- Enter the code you received and choose "open-beta" in the drop-down menu
5- Wait for the Download of the update (you may have to restart Steam)
6- Start Northgard and enjoy the Servers :-)

PATCH NOTE

We also changed a few things in the game (which are also available on the default version):


Tile transfer will appear normally in the end screen summary
We fixed a bug that caused Draugar portals and many other things to remain visible in the end screen summary
Clan members won't start healing before they transform into healers anymore.
We fixed a visual bug sometime occuring with the lighthouse
We fixed a bug in the Fishermen’s animation 
We fixed a bug in the skin of the Warchief when summoned for the second time
You can now train a clan member to become a Sailor even if the boat is at sea!
The exclusive mode will now work properly for two monitors users
The cooldown of Domination (Wolf Clan’s fame 500) has been reduced from 12 to 9 months
Left click on a unit's portrait will now select the closest unit to the camera
We fixed many Null Access errors


PRICING

As we planned when starting the Early Access period, we will be raising Northgard price on Steam from 19,99€ to 27,99€ starting this Friday January 19th. Be sure that there will not be further price raise when the game is officially released! We are also planning to release a Deluxe version of the game, including the Development Artbook and the complete OST!

Thank you so much for your support, you guys are the best! <3

notes.title: PATCH NOTE #18 - December Update
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

We're sorry to announce a little delay in the arrival of dedicated servers in Northgard...

Dedicated Servers

We've had some partnership issues that forced us to postpone the release of this crucial feature to January. We absolutely understand your frustration regarding the problems that poor internet connection and leaving hosts can generate.

Please be sure that our decision on this matter is only motivated by the urge to give you the best multiplayer experience. We'll spend this time to set up an infrastructure that will allow us to have a very large number of Northgard instances running at the same time.

December Update

This problem will not prevent us from delivering you your monthly update :-)

Changes on Tech Trees:

For all clans:

We’ve merge Militia & Defense, giving Defense Strategy: +20% Attack for Villagers & +20% defense for Watch Towers
Feeling Safe has been moved and is now replaced by MonsterSlayer: +30% attack power against Mystical Creatures - Draugar, Valkyries, Giants, Giant Hero (Blainn), Wyvern.
Sharp Weapons has been replaced by Military Strategy: Military units gains +5% attack for each type of friendly military units in the area.
Trading (or Bartering) is now necessary to build a Lighthouse
Erudition buff for Loremaster is now by 20% (previously 10%)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/fa1ac8107f12803fe2372ab941ace9777aef88ef.gif

Clan of the Goat:
Barricade’s bonus now goes from 30% to 20%
Food Trade: Trading food increases your trading routes' income by 50% (previously 100%)

Clan of the Bear:
Shield Master’s bonus goes from 20% resistance to 15% and the tech changes place

Clan of the Raven:
Fame 200 now grants +3 Villagers and +3 Max Population

Clan of the Boar: 

The menders now grant +1 Lore instead of +2
Bartering now grants:

+1 Krowns per 8 population (rounded down)
The ability to trade with Neutrals
Unlocks the Lighthouse (see the Trade Victory Section)
Handiwork takes the place of Nature Gift (which has disappeared)
Handiwork has been replaced by Lay of the Land: -30% chance of being attacked by Wolves, Draugar or Valkyries

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/00adb48b212f5c928ab458847b85c957673c4671.gif

Clan of the Wolf:
Cartography has been removed (very low pick rate) and replaced by Plunder: When decolonizing a tile, the units in this tile are healed by +50%  of their max health
Pillage is now called Spoils of War

New Features

The Clans of the Boar, Raven, Goat and Stag now have different skins for their Warchiefs!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/6eceddd5a9fceef966d55138a1dc5085e796d9f1.gif
When creating a multiplayer game, you can now choose the difficulty of each AI and the hostility of Northgard separately
When creating a FFA game with AI players, the AI will now be placed on Northgard randomly (in previous versions, the AIs were always grouped)
We changed the way victory is displayed when winning in team (the game now congratulates every member of the winning team)!
We changed the way the ESC button works. ESC will close each active window and only then open the menu.
When someone is kicked from a lobby, they won’t have the possibility to re-enter the lobby
When someone leaves a game, they will be replaced by an AI after 5 minutes. If the player reconnects, he will take back control of his clan. The AI difficulty is scaled on the hostility of Northgard.
We changed a few more things in the way disease works: 
 When a unit gets sick, it will lose 90% of its max health (if a unit has 100hp, it will lose 90hp). The player can heal a unit during the disease. We added the fact that the unit will remain sick if the food or wood production remains < 0.
It is no longer possible for a healer/mender’s hut to heal a unit already healed by another healer/mender’s hut.
We upped the damages of the AxeThrowers by 20%
Upgrading military buildings will now only grant a +5% attack power bonus (10% previously)


Trade Victory

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/4c077c479d94ec7c6a5ce44df40dc09e6c53314a.gif

We completely changed the way the trade victory worked: 

To win a Trade victory, you now need to build a Lighthouse
The Lighthouse can be built as an extension to a Longship Dock or a Harbor
This new building extension will allow you to gain access to “Great Trade Routes”
These will allow you to send Kröwns to various locations and gain Commercial Influence:
Sending Kröwns to your homeland on the continent will grant you +5 in Commercial Influence for -5 Kröwns
Sending Kröwns to Miklagard will grant you +10 in Commercial Influence in exchange for -20 Krowns
Sending Kröwns to Vinland will grant you +15 in Commercial Influence in exchange for -40 Krowns
You cannot build more than 1 Lighthouse, and therefore, you cannot have more than 1 Great Trade Route!
To win a Trade victory, you will need to reach 2000 in Commercial Influence



Bug Fixes


When healing Vedrfolnir with x different huts, the achievement was unlocked x times. This has been fixed!
When repairing a military building, players were losing a few Kröwns, this has been fixed
The UI will now allow much more compatibility with various screen resolutions!
Deers now respawn normally
The message “you’re under attack” will now always disappear once this attack is over
When a player loses a game in multiplayer, he is no longer allowed to pause it anymore. This also generated a bug where the “resume the game” button didn’t work.
There was an issue in the way ressources incomes were displayed (the addition of various resources didn’t correspond to the flow). It is now fixed
We fixed most “Zone is null” errors
The map size didn’t worked as intended. You will now be able to play on very large map with any number of players
The achievement "Iron Miner" now requires to mine 60 iron (previously 150) 


Again, we’re sorry for the delay in the server’s release, we hope you’ll have fun with this new update :)

notes.title: Shiro Games Roadmap - What's coming next?
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

We're so glad to see that you adopted the Clan of the Boar! 
We know you cannot wait for new stuff coming to Northgard ;)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/3f3231a7696f4b786293a39b75a1536b94ba9a6b.png

As the official release approaches, it seemed important to give you an overview of what's coming in the game for the last phase of Early Access!

Until multiplayer patch

We've identified a few problems and bugs with the current version of the game, and we're working on solving these :)

Multiplayer Patch - December

This update will introduce something that many of you asked: Dedicated servers. 
Those servers will hopefully grant you more stable and less laggy games, solving the issues of hosts disconnecting!

We'll add many more things to make the experience more fun and intuitive:
- The possibility to choose a different difficulty for Northgard (as the environment) and for each AI individually
- The possibility to kick someone from the lobby (he won't be able to join again)
- The players leaving a game will be replaced by an AI
- The AI will have a more human behavior

In this patch we plan to entirely revisit the Trade Victory, more information about it will soon come.
We'll also add some other smaller things that were missing in the game.

First Campaign update - January 2018

We'll unveal the first 4 chapters of the campaign in the beginning of 2018.
This campaign will tell a story about a young Viking Warchief and his quest for colonizing Northgard!
The player will meet each clan one after the other, interact with them (not all of them have good intentions ;) )

Some changes to the UI and Key Binding will also be implemented at this time.

The end of Early Access Period

We intend to fully release Northgard in Februray-March 2018  (this is an objective, not a certainty ^^).
The period of time between the January update and the official release will be dedicated on solving every little problem that we identify!

Northgard after its official release

The official launch of the game will not mean the end of new features addition, and we're looking into adding new clans, gameplay mechanics, etc...

What would you like to see added into the game? Tell us :-)

https://j.gifs.com/lOj0Z6.gif

A new clan will be released tomorrow: The Clan of the Boar!

https://i.imgur.com/Lnyucgz.gif

PRESENTATION OF THE BOAR

A reclusive clan once forgotten by their brethren but recently rediscovered, the Clan of the Boar is both mystical and untamed. Their understanding of the world is unmatched, as are their boorish and primitive ways.

https://i.imgur.com/dwoMVdv.gif

Starting bonuses

The Mender's Hut replaces the Healer's Hut. Menders produce +2 Lore while they're not healing.
Under The Stars: Each additional tile gives +2 max population.
No happiness penalties for non-upgraded houses.

Heritage (200 Fame points)

1 Free Lore (does not count towards Lore victory or Blessing unlock)

Greater Blessings (500 Fame points)

Blessings have upgraded effects:

Freya: Blizzard penalty reduction: 30% => 50%.
Baldr: happiness +3 => +5
Jörd: Warchief and upgraded towers get +10% att

https://i.imgur.com/5rIXpcM.gif

Lore tree changes

Trading => Bartering: +3 Krowns, Allows trading routes with neutral factions (not other clans)
Mining efficiency => Handiwork: +10% production for non upgraded buildings
Coinage => Simple living: -50% wood construction costs for buildings
Medecine => Herbalism: Each active Mender give +5% production in the Mender’s Hut Territory
Carpentry Mastery => Nature’s Gift: +1 Krowns each 5 clan members
Growth knowledge => Legacy: Altar of Kings production is doubled
Wealth knowledge => Osmosis: Forests, Swamps & Fishes gives +2 happiness


 You'll be able to find the full presentation of this clan in this video! 

NEW FEATURES


Vedrfolnir now has a different description text once he’s healed
As Vedrfolnir crashed after being wounded, there is now a mark on the ground (may need some work)
Vedrfolnir cannot spawn on Magma Flows tiles
There is now a healing icon above the health bar of the healed clan member
ONE NEW MUSIC TRACK! :D
Many new sound FX (victory and loss of a game, ally trading with you, feasting, etc…)
A new special effect for the warrior's charge
Non upgraded silos now grant a +300 max food stock. Upgrading them will raise this to 500.


BUG FIXING

We corrected some issues in the game, here is the list:


Fixed a bug in the way bonuses granted by upgraded silos were calculated
Fixed an issue with the way the game calculated winter food consumption (depending on the size of the clan population)
The Altar of King bonuses weren't always displayed
Forests had a chance not to be occupied by wolves
The mining exploit has been fixed: it is not possible to extend indefinitely the stone and iron reserves in a mine
When reaching 0 in a traded ressource, the trade route just stops
A lot of "NULL ACCESS" and "CALLED FROM" errors have been fixed 


We worked hard on this update, and we hope you'll have fun playing the Clan of the Boar! :-)

https://i.imgur.com/8V1iv1c.png

notes.title: Northgard update adds Thor worship tiles and a new trading faction
notes.content: When T.J. tried it out Early Access RTS Northgard in February he enjoyed the Viking theme and the Age of Empires-style combat—and the game has come a long way since then. Developer Shiro Games has pushed out regular updates, the latest of which adds a new faction to the game called the Kobolds, as well as fresh resource tiles and a mystical hawk that will scout the map for you.The Kobold will set up camp at various points in the map near precious resources. They're neutral but they'll protect that loot with their life. So, you can set up trade routes with them or, if you're feeling brave, confront them head on and try to wipe them out. But they're tough to beat, and if you do overcome them you won't be able to trade with them in future, naturally. At first glance, it's a neat dynamic.The update also adds new tiles for the map, namely geysers, lakes and Thor’s Wrath. Lakes are choc full of fish to keep your clan nourished while geysers grant happiness (because you can relax around them), as well as heat that will reduce resource consumption in the winter. Claiming Thor's Wrath will please the hammer-wielding god of thunder, granting you an attack boost.The last major addition is Vedrfolnir, a hawk that you'll find hidden somewhere on the map. It's hurt, but if you nurse it to full health it will scout the map for you, revealing new areas.Shiro Games has made smaller changes too: you'll now receive a notification whenever your units enter a fight, for example. The full list of tweaks is in the patch notes.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE #16 - v0.3.6363
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

This month, we added many things  to the game! Here is the list of the modifications!

New content:

Vedrfolnir, the mystical hawk

https://j.gifs.com/862B1m.gif

This spectacular creature has been harmed by Draugar and you might find him, hurting somewhere around Northgard. Once you heal him to full health, Vedrfolnir will rise and you’ll earn 100 Lore.

Once healed, he’ll wander around Northgard for a whole year and will discover   6 new areas for your clan!

New neutral faction: The Kobolds

https://j.gifs.com/kZROOY.gif

They occupy several tiles in the map that may have precious resources. If you player want to get these resources you'll have to wipe their camp. But doing so, you'll lose the ability to trade with the Kobolds. Be cautious: they are pretty generous allies but very resentful enemies.

New tile: Thor’s Wrath

https://j.gifs.com/W76jAQ.gif

Control the Thor’s Wrath tile and become a follower of the hammer-wielding god of thunder! Colonizing this tile will grant you 50 Fame and 5% factionwide bonus attack power.

New tile: Lake

https://i.imgur.com/AT0UhxH.jpg

The new lake tile always has fish and the Bear Clan have great chances to have one near their town hall. The cost of the Fisherman's hut has been reduced from 60 to 40 wood.

New tile: the Geyser

https://i.imgur.com/2XuecbD.jpg

Your clan can now relax around this nice hot water source. Colonizing a Geyser tile will grant the player +1 in happiness and will reduce wood consumption during winter by 10%. 

Other additions

You are now notified whenever your units enter a fight (if you didn’t initiate the fight)
You can now choose the target of your healers in the healer's hut
Disease modification: a sick unit now loses 50% of its max HP and then stops being sick.
Rat infestation now gets some of your units sick (how many depends on your population).
When your population is starving or freezing, buying food or wood while keeping your food or wood production below 0 won’t reset your starvation/freezing status anymore. Having a positive stock of resources will reduce slowly the number of starving/frozen units. Having a positive production rate will reset the starvation/freezing status.


Lore changes

Industrious: Only food generating building now can have an extra worker when upgraded
Carpentry masteries : down from 30% to 20% upgrade cost reduction
Goat Amenities has been moved. It now replaces ShipBuilding (formerly replaced Medecine).

notes.title: PATCH NOTE #15 - Combat update - v0.2.6084
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians! 

Here are the modifications we made to the game! You'll see the combat system has changed a lot and we truly think it is for the best :)


Combat Update

https://j.gifs.com/oYpvMj.gif

General units modifications

    When entering an area, there is now a 0.8 seconds cooldown before being able to attack, this will prevent tile dancing.
    You can now see every unit in a multiple unit selection, with their individual life bar
    In this group panel, you can select all the units from a specific type by CTRL+click on one of the units
    When fighting, the military units now have color circles beneath them to increase fight clarity
    Redesign of the unit life-bars (with clan color)
    There are now 3 different stats for each units (before patch, Health & Resistance were combined in one stat):

    Attack
    Health
    Resistance



https://j.gifs.com/Q1ZNYl.gif

Upgrade changes

    Upgrading the Traning Camp, the Shield Bearer Camp and the Axe Thrower Camp now grants a boost in attack (10%) instead of defense
    Upgrading the WatchTower will increase its health by 75% (50% before the patch) and its attack power by 75% (0% before the patch). In addition, the towers won't start burning when being hit until their health goes under 80%!
    The AI now upgrades its units tools
    In the tool upgrade tab, you'll get the possibility to upgrade your villagers, increasing their building & repair speed by 15%, but they won't gather more food.
    In the tool upgrade tab, military units now have brand new abilities that will cost 50 of Krowns and 10 of Iron:

    When upgrading the Warriors, he will gain 15% attack power and a charging ability. This ability will allow them to sprint towards their enemies. 
    When upgrading the Shield Bearers, their protection against ranged attack is doubled, and their resistance increased by 20%
    When upgrading the Axe Throwers, they will gain 30% in range and attack power
    Note that the Goat clan won't be able to upgrade its military units with its free tools 



https://j.gifs.com/Bgl8DX.gif

Military units modifications

    The respawn cooldown for all WarChiefs (including Kaija, the Armored Bear) has been raised from 1 to 3 months.
    The Berserker Heath has been reduced by 30% and its Defense has been increased by 30%. This won’t change anything in the balance of the game, the modification only objective is to make the code smoother :)
    The Shieldmaiden’s defense had been increased by 7%
    Kaija, the Armored Bear’s defense has been raised by 5% and its Health by 7%. In addition, in addition  its cost is now 75 food (and yes, she has a name now).
    The Axe throwers base attack is reduced by 15% and their base range is reduced by 30%
    The ShiedBearer’s arrow resistance ability is reduced from 50% to 20%
    The Mercenaries have been modified:

    Sending them now costs 200 Krowns
    Their attack has been increased by 10%
    Their defense has been reduced by 55%
    Sending mercenaries will now summon 4 units (3 before patch)



https://j.gifs.com/Y6oQ4p.gif

PVE units modifications

    The Wolf attack has been raised by 15%
    The Bear defense has been increased by 20% and its Health by 7%
    BIG CHANGES on Draugrs:

    Their health has been raised by 20%
    There are now 3 different types of Draugr:

    The melee draugr 
    The Spear Thrower Draugr ⇒ launches spears
    The Shield Draugr ⇒ has a 20% resistance against AxeThrowers and Towers Arrows


    The Valkyries are much more stronger now:
    Their attack has been raised by 25%
    Their Defense has been raised by 33%
    Their Health has been increased by 15%
    To counter balance this modification, we changed a few things about Helheim:

    Valkyries base number is changed from 5 to 4
    Valkyries spawn rate has been divided by 2



Other modifications

https://j.gifs.com/r0yEJ6.gif


The wood production bonus provided by a forest drops from 20% to 10%
The lore production bonus provided by the Circle of Lorestone drops from 20% to 10%
Killing the Wyvern now grants 250 fame to every ally in the team
Young & Proud and Gear Upgrade now have a more accurate description
It is now possible to upgrade a tool if the building of the unit is built, even there are no units.
Better repartition of resources surrounding landing site
Tiles containing Stone and Iron mines surrounding the player’s landing site will be less difficult to colonize (no bear or draugr to defend them)
Players in MP games now won’t have more than 2 Pauses available, after 30 seconds, any player can unpause the game
Scouts are not allowed to scout enemy territory (another player or AI) unless the scout camp is upgraded
The AI will now progress more slowly in the beginning of games but it will be more efficient in late game.


Bug fixing

Two player should not be able to spawn next to one another
The repair of a WatchTower stops when it is attacked (but not when enemy units enter the area
The Achievements issues should now be fixed!
The wolves won't randomly change target


In conclusion

We really hope you'll enjoy those changes, we truly think they will help balancing the game.
Regarding the upcoming updates, we're working hard on a major Multiplayer update, as we really want Northgard to be a stable MP game! However, we won't be able to guarantee that it will come next month (but we hope so). 

Have fun my dear Northgardians :-)

https://j.gifs.com/lOj0Z6.gif

notes.title: Patch notes #14 - v0.2.5876
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

As planned, this patch will mainly correct some disturbing bugs, and change some aspects of the balance between clans! 

Here is the detail of what we've changed :-)


Clan Balancing

http://i.imgur.com/hRPYlz6.jpg
Clan of the Goat - Buff
[olist]
    Sheepfold costs now 60 Wood instead of 80
    Barricades increase the villagers resistance by 30% instead of 20%
    Team Work (Fame 2) now also grants you a free fest
[/olist]

http://i.imgur.com/77zo0pI.jpg
Clan of the Bear - Buff
[olist]
    Food production loss in winter is reduced to 30% instead of 20% (Fame 0). This bonus now also affects wood consumption
    Fame 2 : You'll win less fame by unit killed (5->3) but for each 100 fame points, the bear military units gain 1% power (when reaching 500 fame, the player will get a 5% bonus power, going up from there)
    Winter festival reduction loss of food during winter goes from 10 to 30%
[/olist]

http://i.imgur.com/ZzxSRw2.jpg
Clan fo the Raven - Buff
[olist]
    With the Ranger tech, the raven's scout can no longer be hurt and consume no food
    Mercenaries have higher resistance (+15%)
    The colonization of new tiles by spending Krowns is cheaper (you needed to spend 50% of the food cost when colonizing with Krowns, this ratio is now 40%)
    The mercenaries also loot ressources from the tiles they attack (depending on the tile, there will be a little icon to show which ressource you'll get)

    60 food if raid on empty tiles
    80 food if raid a food providing tile (fish, deer, farm)
    5 iron or 5 stone if raid on iron or stone providing tile
    50 lore if  raid on lore providing tile


[/olist]

http://i.imgur.com/QRNmiGG.jpg
Clan of the Wolf - Nerf
[olist]
    The wild animal will give less food ==> 20 for wolves instead of 30 & 140 for bears instead of 150
    The happiness provided by a military unit came from 1 to 0.5 (you will need 2 units to get 1 happiness)

[/olist]


Bug fixing & other modifications

[olist]
    There is now a cooldown when breaking an attack (prevent hammering and animation skipping)
    We enhanced the animation synchronization, fixing the damage bugs where different animation dealt different amounts of damages.
    Farmer, miner and smith get +10% attack bonus
    The scout camps upgrade stone cost has been halved (5 Stone instead of 10)
    We added color variants for the giants, the wolves and the deers
[/olist]

notes.title: PATCH NOTE #13 - the Clan of the Bear - v0.2.5526
notes.content:
Hello Northgardians!

A new MAJOR update has been pushed to Northgard and we are incredibly proud to present to you The Clan of the Bear!

The Clan of the Bear:

Stalwart protector of the land, the clan of Bjarki is home to the most resilient warriors. Hailing from the northern reaches of the realm, they are also very well suited to survive the harsh winters of Northgard.

Starting Bonuses:
Food production loss during winter is reduced by 20%
Instead of having reduced power, your military units gain 10% resistance bonus during winter.

http://i.imgur.com/qDpNKZ6.jpg

Exclusive units:

Playing with the Clan of the Bear will allow you to have access to two new and unique units:

http://i.imgur.com/Miv1k0z.jpgThe Armored Bear is a powerful defensive unit that cannot enter enemy territory. However, its summoning cost being quite low (50 food), and its armor level quite high, it is the perfect unit to clear the territories surrounding your landing area early in the game.

http://i.imgur.com/mixFO7b.jpg
The Shield Maiden replaces the Warchief of the other clans. She is a stalwart defender of her people and the reason the Clan of the Bear will never falter! In comparison with the other Warchiefs, she has a lower attack ratio but a tremendous defense that will allow her to lead her armies and survive until victory is hers!

Fame Bonuses:
Kindred Spirit: Having an Armored Bear or a Shield Maiden in an area increases local production by 15%
The Bear Awakens: You gain +5 Fame per enemy unit killed in an area with the Shield Maiden..


Knowledge:
Hibernation: Your clan members will heal themselves during winter when in your territory.Protector of the Land: Gain +1 Happiness per area with at least one military camp.Shield Mastery: Shield Bearers cost less money and their resistance is increasedHarpoons: Fisherman's Huts can have one more Fisherman and their production is increasedWinter Festivals: Food production loss in winter reduced by 10% & +2 Happiness during winter.
We’re not going to say a lot more in this post, as you would have noticed we just pushed the update to you. So go… update, test, discover! Let us know what you think, we’re sure that you’ll want to find out how well we managed to balance the clan, and we’d love to hear your feedback on how we did.

But wait... There's more!

Changes to other clans:

We studied the balance in the game and made a few changes in the other clans specificities. Here are a few tweaks that we’ve made that should change the way you play a little.

The Clan of the Goat:
They no longer get reduced food consumption for their villagers, but they get the 30% feasting bonus from the startThe two free tools are now acquired when reaching 200 FameAt 500 Fame, they will now obtain the new "Team Work" Fame step: their defense towers and all their military units gain 20% resistance when feasting.
The Clan of the Wolf:
The Berserker's attack power has been reduced by ~10%The Conqueror knowledge now gives +100% against defense towers instead of +200%When reaching 200 Fame, Assault now gives +15% attack bonus instead of +20%
The general AI :

Following our previous patch and your feedback (THANK YOU SO MUCH), we made many improvements to AI which should now prove to be a much stronger opponent - especially in Hard mode. Give us your feedback here! 

Other changes
During winters, if you don't have Fur Coats (and if you are not playing the Bear clan), you will now get -10% attack power inside your territory (and still -30% outside of it)Erudition Knowledge has been swapped with Shipbuilding, and has been changed to the following : "Increases Lore Masters production by 10%. Carved stones cost is halved."Feeling safe now apply to all military camp buildings instead of Training Camp onlyThe order of the profession icons in the lower right corner has been changed to improve usability
Last but not least, thank you. Thank you to everyone who got behind Northgard and helped us launch the game successfully into Early Access. Thanks for buying it, sharing it with your friends, making videos, tweeting, liking, twitching, writing articles, reporting bug, sharing your ideas or just playing the game and having fun. Without you guys we wouldn’t be thinking so ambitiously about our future plans for multiplayer, adding more mechanics and generally pushing the game a lot further.

Thanks again and stay awesome.

The Shiro Games Team

notes.title: Patch notes #12 : Player Profile and Strategic Map v0.1.5155
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's time for another patch for Northgard and another step towards v1.0!

On the menu today, we have:

Player Profile:
We have added a new Profile section in the main menu where you will find some statistics about the games you've played. These stats come with their obligatory Steam achievements of course, so have fun unlocking them! Please note that we will only start recording your stats from this patch on so previous victories will not appear.

Your rank will also be shown in multiplayer mode so you'll know if you're going into a match with other experienced players or not.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/e3d1734d543177eba39507b45676ed30134c4476.jpg

Strategic Map:
We've added a new set of buttons to the mini-map.

One allows you to toggle the display mode between resources (the default) and strategy, which will show all players' visible warband units and defense towers, allowing you to understand enemy positions and movements when things are heating up.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/cc14cc95529310248d8233a77f3caa3e9936069c.jpg

Other UI changes:
We made additional changes to the user interface:
Fixed a bug that was preventing people from clicking buttons on the end of game replay screen.
On military buildings (Training Camp, etc.) you can now toggle a "rally to Warchief" option. This means that once trained, the warrior will move directly to the current Warchief position.
Victory progress: we've put the fame score for other players/AI back however now their victory progress will only start showing when they reach 75%. You can still view current progress through the victory progress screen.
You can no longer see the icon of unmet clans on the victory progress screen.
You can now select your entire warband with a single click using the new button that has been added to your unit list.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/2f1f088554df7d53e88bdefff2f05cb68e9bb120.jpg

DirectX Beta:
A fair few of you have reported some serious crashes or were simply not able to start the game at all. Based on your feedback it seems this was due to some faulty OpenGL drivers, and some graphics card manufacturers which didn't push updates to address this.

Over the past few weeks we've been working on a DirectX version designed specifically to solve these problems. This is now available to test through a beta branch of the game.

In order to test out the new version, right click on Northgard in your steam games library, then go to Properties, select the Beta tab and choose the DirectX Beta version. Wait the game to update and start it.

If DirectX Beta does not show in the beta list, restart steam to update it.

You can tell which version you are running by looking at the version (DirectX or OpenGL) showing at the bottom right of the title screen.

Please report any issue you might have with this version, depending on the feedback we might make it the default in our next patch.

Anti-Cheating:
We have received our first reports of some people cheating in game. Please keep in mind that Northgard is not using dedicated servers so we can't guarantee a 100% cheating free experience.

That being said, we have put in place some measures to prevent the most obvious ways of cheating, we hope that this will be enough to discourage the cheaters, although as you know, there's one in every crowd...

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25920479/bf21d7d0167c87172b617abf4602ca4a3725ced0.jpg

AI Improvements:
We have started working more seriously on AI, with the goal of having a very strong and challenging AI in Hard Mode. We only started a few days ago but we will keep you posted on how things are going.

Other changes:
We made numerous other changes and little fixes, here are the most important ones:
Prevented axe throwers and hunters from continuing to fire when a target is out of range (no more axes going across an entire tile!)
Fixed display of some global bonuses in attack/defense if you are not host in multiplayer (the bonus was previously correctly applied, but not displayed properly).
Added new dedicated skins to the buildings for training axe throwers and shield bearers.
Fixed bug where sometimes you could not place a field on fertile land.
Sailors Lore production is back to +1 instead of +1.5.
Circle of Stones Lore bonus is now +30% instead of +50%.
Amount of food traded to have the Giants join you has been reduced by 20%.
Ship Building wisdom is now +30% instead of +50%.
Coinage is now +20% instead of +30%.
Gear Upgrade and Young and Proud are now maxed to +25% bonus.
Young and Proud now replaces Sharp Weapons instead of Defensive Strategy.
End nerf-fest.

notes.content:
Hi there!

First the whole team would like to thank all of you for the successful launch of the multiplayer! 

Many of your are playing day and night and we have received a lot of positive feedback and improvements suggestions. It will take some time to process everything and patch the game, so thanks in advance for your patience!

Meanwhile, we are currently focusing on solving the remaining technical problems to provide the best possible experience.

Out of Memory

We have been working hard at solving this issue, it's not an easy one as it involves some crazy words such as "Address space layout randomization" and "Address space fragmentation"

This new patch provides some improvements in that area, we hope it will definitely fix the problem, please report to us if you're still experimenting "Out of memory" error messages.

Game doesn't start

The current version of Northgard uses OpenGL for 3D rendering. We found that some of you have some errors at game startup, in particular if you have an Intel HD graphics card which is quite common on laptops.

In order to fix this, we are currently working on a DirectX version of the game, it will take us a few more weeks before we can provide a beta to you for testing but we are dedicated to fixing this. Thanks again for your patience.

Other errors

Sometimes you might see an error window showing during the game. If it's an out of memory error please report it to us, otherwise we are logging these on our server in order to know where to focus our efforts.

We have been fixing several of these in the current patch and we will continue doing so in the upcoming weeks.

Thank you!
